5次完整累计加1次尾更新，共6步；尾组损失缩放需按实际样本数处理。
transfer.answer: 5次完整累计加1次尾更新，共6步；尾组损失缩放需按实际样本数处理。

blocks.text: An iteration is one defined training-loop cycle; an optimizer step actually updates parameters; an epoch traverses a finite training dataset once. Code and streaming-data conventions must be stated.

With N samples and batch size B, keeping the final partial batch gives ceil(N/B) batches per epoch. Updating every A batches reduces the update count, with the final incomplete accumulation handled by an explicit rule.
For 1,000 samples and batches of 100, one epoch has 10 iterations if one iteration is one batch. With accumulation over 2 batches, that epoch has 5 optimizer steps. Ten iterations are not ten epochs.

depth.boundary: Gradient accumulation or skipped updates means these counts are not interchangeable.

introduction.definition: Kadane算法逐个读取数组，保存“必须在当前位置结束”的最大连续子数组和。
introduction.example: 数组[−2,3,−1,4]，要求子数组非空。

exercise.question: 遇负数就应立即清零吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，−1连接3和4，保留可得到6。

derivation: 以i结束的最优解要么单独a[i]，要么接在前一最优后，end=max(a[i],end+a[i])。
全局best记录所有end的最大值；非空问题以首元素初始化。

calculation.scenario: 数组[−2,3,−1,4]，要求子数组非空。

application.scenario: 寻找日收益序列中累计收益最大的连续区间。
steps: 遍历时在重新开始子数组处记录起点，best改善时保存区间。
输出区间和及边界；若是复合收益应先明确不能直接把简单收益求和当精确复利。
application.result: 输出区间和及边界；若是复合收益应先明确不能直接把简单收益求和当精确复利。

transfer.question: 全负数组[−5,−2,−7]结果是什么？
steps: end依次−5、−2、−7，best最大为−2。
非空答案是[−2]，返回0会错误允许空子数组。
transfer.answer: 非空答案是[−2]，返回0会错误允许空子数组。

blocks.text: Maximum subarray sum can define the state as "the largest non-empty consecutive sum that must end at the current position". The new element is either connected to the previous interval or starts over; choose the larger value between the two, and then use the global answer to record the maximum value among all end points. The state only needs the previous value, so it can be squeezed into constant extra space.

For [-2,3,-1,4], the best sum ending at the final position comes from [3,-1,4]. If every value is negative, choose the largest negative value. Initializing the answer to zero would incorrectly allow an empty subarray.
例子：数组 (−2,3,−1,4,−5)，记录“必须在当前位置结束”的最大和，依次为 −2、3、2、6、1，全局最大为 6，对应 (3,−1,4)。递推为 end=max(x,end+x)；若要求非空子数组，全负输入也不能返回空集的 0。

depth.boundary: An all-negative array still needs to return a negative number, which cannot be replaced by an empty interval of zero.

introduction.definition: KL散度衡量用分布Q描述来自P的数据，相比直接用P多付出多少平均对数代价。

exercise.question: 交换P、Q结果一定相同吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，KL有方向，不是对称距离。

derivation: 定义D(P‖Q)=ΣPᵢln(Pᵢ/Qᵢ)，Pᵢ=0的项按极限记0。
若Pᵢ>0却Qᵢ=0，编码该事件代价无限，KL为无穷。

steps: 第二项为0，所以KL≈0.6931自然单位。
calculation.result: 第二项为0，所以KL≈0.6931自然单位。

application.scenario: 蒸馏时让学生概率接近教师。
steps: 声明方向为教师P到学生Q，并让学生对教师支持集保持正概率。
按类别求和后按样本平均，注意工具接口是否要求输入log概率。
application.result: 按类别求和后按样本平均，注意工具接口是否要求输入log概率。

transfer.question: 反过来D(Q‖P)是多少？
steps: Q在第二类有0.5，但P在该类为0。
出现正概率除以0，因此反向KL无穷，展示不对称。
transfer.answer: 出现正概率除以0，因此反向KL无穷，展示不对称。

blocks.text: KL divergence measures a discrepancy between probability distributions. It can train a student model to match a teacher’s distribution or constrain a new policy from moving too far from a reference policy. KL divergence is generally asymmetric, so the direction of comparison matters. It is not a geometric distance or a direct measure of semantic similarity between answers. Cross-entropy, KL divergence and entropy are related, but explain which distributions are being compared rather than treating them as interchangeable losses.
例子：P=(0.5,0.5)，Q=(0.25,0.75)，KL(P∥Q)=0.5log(2)+0.5log(2/3)≈0.1438。交换 P、Q 得约 0.1308，因此 KL 不对称。若 P 在某处有正概率而 Q 为零，该方向的 KL 可以无穷大。

depth.boundary: KL divergence is not a symmetric distance, and input conventions depend on the implementation.

concepts.title: K-nearest Neighbors · K 近邻预测

introduction.definition: KNN用邻近已标注样本预测新样本；K-means把未标注样本分组并反复更新组中心。
introduction.example: 一维点[0,2,8,10]，K-means初始中心0与10。

exercise.question: 两者的k含义一样吗？
exercise.answer: 不同，KNN是邻居数，K-means是分组数。

derivation: K-means交替把点分配给最近中心，再把中心移到组均值以降低平方距离和。
KNN不求这些中心，查询时计算距离并汇总最近标签。

calculation.scenario: 一维点[0,2,8,10]，K-means初始中心0与10。
steps: 首轮分组{0,2}与{8,10}，新中心分别1与9。

application.scenario: 按客户行为做探索分群。
steps: 先缩放不同量纲特征，用多个初始中心运行K-means。
检查群体稳定性与业务含义，不能自动把聚类编号当真实标签。
application.result: 检查群体稳定性与业务含义，不能自动把聚类编号当真实标签。

transfer.question: KNN最近3个标签为[猫,狗,狗]时预测什么？
steps: 不加权投票中狗有2票、猫1票。
预测狗；若改距离加权需重新按距离计算，不能直接复用多数票。
transfer.answer: 预测狗；若改距离加权需重新按距离计算，不能直接复用多数票。

blocks.text: K 近邻预测（KNN）利用距离最近的已标注训练样本进行分类或回归。K-means 是无监督聚类，定义统一放在聚类页；两者都用距离，但不应在两个基础入口重复解释 K-means。
对查询 x 找到 K 个邻居集合 N_K(x)。分类按标签票数或距离权重投票；回归可用 $\hat y=K^{-1}\sum_{i\in N_K(x)}y_i$。K 为邻居数，距离、尺度、并列与权重规则都须预先规定，不能用测试标签选择 K。
查询 x=2.1，训练点为 (1,A)、(2,A)、(3,B)、(9,B)，取欧氏距离与 K=3，最近三点标签 A、B、A，预测为 A。这使用了训练标签；把同一批未标注点分成簇的 K-means 则是另一个任务。

depth.boundary: KNN is covered in Chapter 29. Similar names do not imply the same task.

distinctions.title: Clustering
distinctions.reason: KNN 使用邻居的已知标签预测新样本；K-means 根据距离组织无标签数据，定义集中在聚类页。相似名称不代表同一任务。

concepts.title: KV Cache / FlashAttention · 注意力推理的缓存与访存

introduction.definition: KV缓存复用已生成词的键和值；FlashAttention改变注意力的内存访问方式，避免完整存储大分数矩阵。
introduction.example: 1层、2个头、长度4、每头维度3，K与V均用2字节元素。

exercise.question: KV缓存会让上下文内存不再随长度增长吗？
exercise.answer: 不会，缓存仍随保存词数线性增加。

derivation: 自回归只新增一个词的K、V，旧词不变时可直接复用。
FlashAttention用分块与在线归一化计算相同注意力目标，主要节省内存读写。

calculation.scenario: 1层、2个头、长度4、每头维度3，K与V均用2字节元素。
steps: 存储48×2=96字节；不含批次、分配器及其他激活。
calculation.result: 存储48×2=96字节；不含批次、分配器及其他激活。

application.scenario: 降低语言模型逐词生成延迟。
steps: 启用KV缓存并验证位置编码、掩码与缓存长度一致。
使用支持的高效注意力内核并测端到端延迟，两者解决的成本不同。
application.result: 使用支持的高效注意力内核并测端到端延迟，两者解决的成本不同。

transfer.question: 长度从4变8，其余不变，缓存多少？
steps: 存储192字节，翻倍而非变为4倍；完整注意力矩阵元素才随长度平方增长。
transfer.answer: 存储192字节，翻倍而非变为4倍；完整注意力矩阵元素才随长度平方增长。

blocks.text: KV cache 保存自回归推理中已处理 token 的键和值，供后续 token 复用。FlashAttention 则通过分块等方式减少注意力计算的中间存储和数据搬运；它不是另一种 KV cache，两者可以配合使用。注意力的数学机制见基础链接。
简化地，L 层、缓存 T 个 token、每层 H 个 KV 头、每头维度 d、每个数 b 字节时，键和值共占 \(M=2LTHdb\) 字节，不计分配器和额外元数据。复用需要模型版本、位置、前缀及其他影响状态的配置兼容。缓存避免重复投影，并没有免除新 token 读取历史键值的工作。
L=2、T=100、H=2、d=4、b=2 时，示意 KV 存储为 6400 字节。T 翻倍，这部分存储也翻倍。更换模型权重后，旧状态不能仅因输入文字相同就继续使用；跨请求的共享还要满足各自数据和访问边界。

worked.title: KV Cache: Which Computations Are Reused?
worked.scenario: During causal autoregressive decoding, four tokens have already been processed. Now process the fifth token to predict the sixth. Keys and values for the first four tokens are cached separately at each layer.
steps: Reuse the first four tokens’ cached K and V instead of recomputing their projections. Compute Q, K and V for the fifth token and append its K and V to the cache.
The fifth token’s query attends to the visible keys for tokens 1…5 and weights their values. Its final representation predicts the sixth token. This attention work still grows with prefix length.
Suppose each token stores 2 groups of d values, each b bytes. For L layers, T tokens and batch size B, simplified memory use is 2BLTdb.
worked.result: Before processing the fifth token, B=1, L=2, T=4, d=8 and b=2 give 256 bytes of cached values. Here d is the total cached key width per layer, with the same width assumed for values. After appending the fifth token, the same formula gives 320 bytes.
worked.pitfall: GQA/MQA, quantization, paging and framework metadata change real memory use. KV caching and FlashAttention optimize different aspects of inference.
worked.question: What happens when length doubles under this simplified cache formula?
worked.answer: Cache size doubles. This does not establish that total inference time exactly doubles.

depth.boundary: Cache management, numerical quantization, and kernel optimization are different techniques.

introduction.definition: 学习率控制沿梯度更新参数时迈多大一步。
introduction.example: 损失L=θ²/2，θ=2，学习率0.1。

exercise.question: 学习率越大一定学得越快吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，可能越过低谷甚至发散。

derivation: 梯度为θ，更新θ新=θ−ηθ=(1−η)θ。
此二次函数中abs(1−η)<1即0<η<2时收敛，实际网络不能直接照搬该界。

calculation.scenario: 损失L=θ²/2，θ=2，学习率0.1。

application.scenario: 新模型训练初期损失振荡。
steps: 固定数据与优化器，比较较小学习率是否降低振荡，并记录梯度尺度。
用验证表现选计划，不能仅凭前几步训练下降确定最佳学习率。
application.result: 用验证表现选计划，不能仅凭前几步训练下降确定最佳学习率。

transfer.question: 若η=3，此例会怎样？
steps: 损失8大于原2，后续绝对值每步翻倍并发散。
transfer.answer: 损失8大于原2，后续绝对值每步翻倍并发散。

blocks.text: The learning rate controls the overall step size of optimizer updates. It measures neither how much knowledge has been learned nor how many epochs training has run. Imagine searching for low ground: the update direction tells you where to move, and the learning rate influences how far to move. Optimizers can also use historical gradients to scale individual parameter updates, so the learning rate is not the absolute change applied to every parameter.

If the stride length is too large, it may cross the favorable area at once, oscillate back and forth, and even cause numerical instability in training. Steps that are too small may result in slow improvement within a given budget. There is no single value that is best for all models, batch sizes, and optimizers. A smaller learning rate does not guarantee that the final generalization will be better, because the training budget, data, and other settings jointly affect the results.

Suppose two runs each train for ten epochs. With a learning rate that is too small, one may learn little in that time, while a suitable learning rate gives the other good validation performance. Equal epoch counts do not imply equal optimization progress. Conversely, unstable loss is not always caused by the learning rate: labels, the loss implementation or numerical precision may also be responsible.

worked.title: Learning Rate: Convergence, Oscillation and Divergence
worked.scenario: Use the simplified objective L(θ)=θ²/2, with gradient θ, initial θ=4 and fixed learning rate η.
steps: The update is θ_next=(1-η)θ. At η=0.1, 4→3.6→3.24 approaches 0 slowly.
At η=1.8, 4→-3.2→2.56 alternates sign but shrinks in magnitude, so still converges.
At η=2.2, 4→-4.8→5.76 alternates sign and grows in magnitude, so diverges.
worked.result: For this quadratic with curvature exactly 1, 0<η<2 converges; η=2 gives constant-amplitude oscillation; η=1 reaches 0 in one step.
worked.pitfall: (0,2) is not a universally safe learning-rate range for neural networks. Curvature, noise and the optimizer change stability conditions.
worked.question: For L=5θ²/2, what is the stable range of fixed learning rates?
worked.answer: The gradient is 5θ and the update factor is 1-5η. Requiring its absolute value to be below 1 gives 0<η<0.4.

worked.title: Weight Decay and Learning-Rate Decay: Different Controls
worked.scenario: Use the simplified decoupled update θ_next=(1-ηλ)θ-ηg for shrinkage and gradient updates, with θ=2, η=0.1, λ=0.01 and g=0.4.
steps: The shrinkage factor is 0.999, giving the shrunk parameter 1.998.
The gradient term is 0.04, giving 1.958 after the update. With λ=0, the same step gives 1.96.
Reducing the next step’s learning rate to 0.01 changes the schedule for η. λ still sets parameter shrinkage strength.
worked.result: Weight decay shrinks parameters during an update; learning-rate decay describes how η changes over time. Their numerical effects interact because shrinkage contains ηλ.
worked.pitfall: Here g denotes the update direction. Actual AdamW adjusts gradients using momentum and second-moment statistics, so this direction is not simply the raw gradient.
worked.question: If g=0, can weight decay still update the parameter?
worked.answer: Yes. If ηλ is nonzero and decay applies to that parameter, the equation still performs θ←(1-ηλ)θ.

depth.boundary: The learning rate is neither the epoch count nor a fixed change to every weight.

applications.title: Learning Rate · 金融模型中的学习率选择
applications.reason: 把一般更新幅度用于收益模型的历史选参，区分训练更新、样本外评价和实际仓位。

introduction.definition: Logit是概率的对数赔率，也是二分类模型转换成概率前的原始分数。
introduction.example: 正类概率0.8。

exercise.question: logit必须在0与1之间吗？
exercise.answer: 不用，logit可取任意实数。

derivation: 赔率为p/(1−p)，取对数得z=ln(p/(1−p))。
反解p=1/(1+exp(−z))，因此z=0对应p=0.5。

calculation.scenario: 正类概率0.8。
steps: logit=ln4≈1.3863，代回sigmoid恢复0.8。
calculation.result: logit=ln4≈1.3863，代回sigmoid恢复0.8。

application.scenario: 实现稳定二分类训练。
steps: 保留网络原始分数，直接交给BCEWithLogitsLoss。
推理才转概率；概率阈值0.8等价于logit阈值ln4。
application.result: 推理才转概率；概率阈值0.8等价于logit阈值ln4。

transfer.question: 若概率为0.2，logit是多少？
steps: logit=−ln4≈−1.3863，与0.8的logit互为相反数。
transfer.answer: logit=−ln4≈−1.3863，与0.8的logit互为相反数。

blocks.text: In neural classification, a logit usually means an unnormalized real-valued output score before conversion to probabilities. In binary statistical terminology, the logit of a probability is its log odds.
For 0<p<1, z=log(p/(1-p)); its inverse is p=1/(1+exp(-z)). A multiclass model has one raw score per class, usually followed by a joint normalization. Raw scores are not probabilities.
Probability p=0.8 has odds 4 and log odds about 1.386. A raw score z=2 is valid even though probability 2 would be invalid. Calibration still needs checking after score conversion.

depth.boundary: Scores may be negative or exceed one; they are not probabilities.

introduction.definition: 循环不变量是在每次循环边界都成立的事实，用它解释程序为何不会越算越错。
introduction.example: 扫描[2,3,5]求和，处理前i项后s等于这i项之和。

exercise.question: 只证明最后一次循环对就够吗？
exercise.answer: 不够，还需证明初始化与每次保持。

derivation: 初始i=0、s=0等于空前缀之和，性质成立。
每次加a[i]并增加i，性质保持；终止i=n时得到全数组和。

calculation.scenario: 扫描[2,3,5]求和，处理前i项后s等于这i项之和。
steps: 第1次后i=1、s=2；第2次后i=2、s=5。
第3次后i=3、s=10，不变量给出这是完整和。
calculation.result: 第3次后i=3、s=10，不变量给出这是完整和。

application.scenario: 审查二分查找边界。
steps: 明确未排除答案始终位于半开区间[l,r)，再逐分支验证保持。
区间长度严格缩小保证终止，退出后再按目标语义解释l。
application.result: 区间长度严格缩小保证终止，退出后再按目标语义解释l。

transfer.question: 若求和循环先令i加1再读a[i]，原证明还成立吗？
steps: 会跳过a[0]并在尾部访问a[n]。
保持步骤被破坏，必须调整读取下标或更新顺序。
transfer.answer: 保持步骤被破坏，必须调整读取下标或更新顺序。

blocks.text: A loop invariant is a statement true at a particular point of every iteration. Correctness reasoning checks initialization, preservation and the consequence when the loop terminates.
For summing an array, before iteration i the accumulator can satisfy s=Σ_{j<i} a_j. Start with i=0 and s=0; adding a_i preserves the statement for i+1; at i=n it states that s is the entire sum.
For [2,4,1], the accumulator before indices 0,1,2,3 is 0,2,6,7. The invariant explains what the partial result means, rather than only checking that this example happened to finish with 7.

depth.boundary: Examples alone do not prove it; explain why every move preserves possible answers.

introduction.definition: 损失给训练提供信号，目标可再加约束与正则，指标用于解释任务表现。
introduction.example: 数据损失0.4，正则项0.1，正确8例共10例。

exercise.question: 训练目标0.5意味着准确率50%吗？
exercise.answer: 不意味着，两者含义和单位不同。

derivation: 优化目标J=L数据+λR可能包含业务指标没有计算的参数惩罚。
准确率用离散决策计数，不反映同一正确预测的概率置信度。

calculation.scenario: 数据损失0.4，正则项0.1，正确8例共10例。
steps: 准确率8/10=0.8，不能从0.5反推得到。
calculation.result: 准确率8/10=0.8，不能从0.5反推得到。

application.scenario: 比较两个分类模型。
steps: 同时报告数据损失、正则后目标及选定指标，明确降低或升高方向。
按独立验证的业务指标选模型，再检查概率质量和成本。
application.result: 按独立验证的业务指标选模型，再检查概率质量和成本。

transfer.question: 若只把正则系数加倍、预测不变，准确率变吗？
steps: 准确率仍8/10=0.8，说明目标数值变化不一定意味着预测变差。
transfer.answer: 准确率仍8/10=0.8，说明目标数值变化不一定意味着预测变差。

blocks.text: A loss scores model errors and is what training aims to improve. An objective function may also include requirements such as regularization. An evaluation metric indicates whether performance meets the task’s needs. The training objective and reported metric can differ: for example, train a purchase-probability predictor with BCE but assess precision or actual conversion outcomes after deployment. An optimizable loss gives training a direction, without guaranteeing complete alignment with the final business objective.

depth.boundary: Reducing the training objective does not guarantee better business metrics.

introduction.definition: 下界查找找第一个不小于目标的位置，上界查找找第一个大于目标的位置。

exercise.question: 两个边界都指向第一个2吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，下界为下标1，上界为下标3。

derivation: 对单调谓词a[i]≥t找第一次为真即可得下界。
上界把谓词换成a[i]>t，重复元素数量等于上界减下界。

steps: 下界排除1，遇到第一个2在下标1。
上界跳过两个2到下标3，出现次数3−1=2。
calculation.result: 上界跳过两个2到下标3，出现次数3−1=2。

application.scenario: 统计某一天的已排序时间戳。
steps: 用下界查日初，再查次日日初，使用半开时间区间。
两个位置相减得到记录数，不必逐条扫描该日。
application.result: 两个位置相减得到记录数，不必逐条扫描该日。

transfer.question: 目标改为3，边界是多少？
steps: 第一个≥3和第一个>3都是4所在下标3。
两界差0，说明3没有出现；插入位置仍明确为3。
transfer.answer: 两界差0，说明3没有出现；插入位置仍明确为3。

blocks.text: Binary search relies on a monotonic true/false condition, rather than merely a sorted array. To find an insertion position, search for the first value greater than or equal to the target. With a half-open interval [left,right), initialize right to the array length. If the midpoint satisfies the condition, keep the left part including that midpoint; otherwise move left just past it. The search ends when left equals right, giving the boundary.

The invariant must preserve the desired boundary, which may equal the array length. Keep the termination and update rules consistent with either a half-open or a closed search interval. For fixed-width integers, computing the midpoint as left plus half of right-left can avoid the overflow of left+right.

worked.title: Binary Search: Half-Open Intervals and Lower Bound
worked.scenario: In sorted [1,2,2,4,7], find the first position not less than 2. Use [left,right), initially [0,5).
steps: Midpoint 2 contains 2 and satisfies the condition. Move right to 2, retaining possible earlier answers.
Midpoint 1 also contains 2, so move right to 1. Midpoint 0 contains 1 and fails the condition, so move left to 1.
Stop at left=right=1. A boundary may equal the array length. It is an insertion position, not a guarantee that the target exists.
worked.result: The lower bound of 2 is 1; of 3 it is 3; of 8 it is 5. Time O(log n).
worked.pitfall: right is excluded, so it can start at n. Do not index the array directly when the returned boundary equals n.
worked.question: Which other boundary gives the number of occurrences of 2?
worked.answer: The upper bound, the first position greater than 2, is 3. The count is 3-1=2.

worked.title: LIS: Equal Values Replace Rather Than Extend
worked.scenario: For [3,1,2,2,5,4], find the longest strictly increasing subsequence length.
steps: After 3, tails=[3]. Value 1 replaces the first entry not less than 1, giving [1].
The first 2 extends tails to [1,2]. The second 2 replaces the same position without increasing length, preserving strict increase.
Value 5 gives [1,2,5]; 4 then gives [1,2,4]. Length is 3.
worked.result: The answer is 3. Here tails happens to form an actual subsequence, but this is not guaranteed for every input.
worked.pitfall: For [2,3,1], final tails=[1,3] violates the input order and is not a reconstructed subsequence.
worked.question: For a longest nondecreasing subsequence, how should the repeated 2 be handled?
worked.answer: Update the first entry strictly greater than the value, allowing equality to extend the sequence. This input’s nondecreasing length is 4.

depth.boundary: Interval conventions and updates must agree. A boundary position does not itself prove the target exists.

introduction.definition: 宏平均先逐类计算再等权平均；微平均先合并各类计数再计算。
introduction.example: 两类召回率分别9/10与1/2。

exercise.question: 宏平均会按大类样本多而额外加权吗？
exercise.answer: 不会，每类权重相同。

derivation: 宏召回=(R₁+R₂)/2，保留小类影响力。
微召回=(ΣTP)/(ΣTP+ΣFN)，样本多的类贡献更多计数。

calculation.scenario: 两类召回率分别9/10与1/2。

application.scenario: 评估类别不均衡的文档识别。
steps: 同时报告每类样本数和逐类分数，再提供宏与微平均。
少数类重要时优先检查宏与逐类失败，不能被总体高分掩盖。
application.result: 少数类重要时优先检查宏与逐类失败，不能被总体高分掩盖。

transfer.question: 若两类各有10例，召回仍0.9、0.5，微平均多少？
steps: 微召回14/20=0.7，与宏平均相同；原差异来自支持数不等。
transfer.answer: 微召回14/20=0.7，与宏平均相同；原差异来自支持数不等。

blocks.text: For multiclass or multilabel tasks, metrics can be calculated separately for each class and then averaged. Macro averaging gives every class equal weight, making problems in small classes easier to see. Weighted averaging uses weights such as class sample counts, so large classes can dominate. Micro averaging pools the counts first, then calculates the metric, emphasizing overall sample-level performance. All three scores may be called F1 but differ, so comparisons must specify the averaging method.
例子：两类 F1 分别为 0.9、0.5，macro F1 为 0.7。若汇总计数 TP=8、FP=2、FN=4，则 micro F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN)=16/22≈0.7273。宏平均先算各类指标，微平均先汇总计数，不能只改变显示名称。

depth.boundary: Class-frequency-weighted averaging is a separate convention affected by class sample counts.

introduction.definition: 梯度累积把多个小批的梯度合在一起，再进行一次参数更新。
introduction.example: 两个等大微批的平均梯度分别2和4。

exercise.question: 累计两次就等于更新两次吗？
exercise.answer: 不等于，中途不更新参数才对应同一批梯度的组合。

derivation: 等大微批要把每批平均损失除以微批数k，累计后得到全批均值梯度。
不等大微批应按样本数加权；BatchNorm等依赖批统计的操作未必等价。

calculation.scenario: 两个等大微批的平均梯度分别2和4。
steps: 每批损失除2后，累计梯度2/2+4/2=3。

application.scenario: 显存只够每次8张图片，需要有效批32。
steps: 每批损失除4，反传4次，期间不清梯度也不更新。
随后执行一次更新并清梯度，调度器也按更新计步。
application.result: 随后执行一次更新并清梯度，调度器也按更新计步。

transfer.question: 若微批大小分别1和3，均值梯度2和4呢？
steps: 全批应按样本数加权：(1×2+3×4)/4。
正确梯度3.5，简单平均3会错误改变每个样本权重。
transfer.answer: 正确梯度3.5，简单平均3会错误改变每个样本权重。

blocks.text: When GPU memory cannot fit many samples at once, split them into microbatches, run forward and backward passes separately, accumulate their gradients and then update. For example, compute gradients after each microbatch but update parameters only after four microbatches: four iterations correspond to one optimizer step. This gives a larger effective batch, but is not always exactly equivalent to one large batch. BatchNorm statistics, for example, can differ. Gradient accumulation does not mean parameters change after every microbatch.

depth.boundary: Partial final batches, loss normalization, and BatchNorm can affect equivalence to a large batch.

introduction.definition: 混合精度用低精度加速合适运算，并保留关键计算的精度；损失缩放防止小梯度下溢。
introduction.example: 真实梯度0.00001，损失缩放系数1024。

exercise.question: 缩放后的大梯度可以直接更新吗？
exercise.answer: 不行，更新前需反缩放回真实梯度。

derivation: 损失乘S会把所有链式梯度也乘S，使小数较易被表示。
优化器前除回S并检查非有限数，必要时跳过更新并调整尺度。

calculation.scenario: 真实梯度0.00001，损失缩放系数1024。

application.scenario: 在GPU上训练大模型。
steps: 用自动混合精度选择算子类型，配合适用的梯度缩放器。
先反缩放再做梯度裁剪，监控溢出和峰值显存。
application.result: 先反缩放再做梯度裁剪，监控溢出和峰值显存。

transfer.question: 若缩放后出现Inf，继续除1024能修好吗？
steps: Inf除以有限数仍为Inf，信息已经丢失。
跳过该更新、降低尺度并排查数值来源，不能照常应用。
transfer.answer: 跳过该更新、降低尺度并排查数值来源，不能照常应用。

blocks.text: These names denote floating-point formats. Lower precision generally saves memory and can accelerate computation on supported hardware, but the numerical range and resolution differ. BF16 has an exponent range similar to FP32 but lower precision; FP16 has a narrower representable range. Mixed precision uses different formats for different operations, often retaining higher precision for sensitive calculations. It does not simply make all numbers smaller, and does not guarantee equal speedups on every device.
例子：一个梯度为 10⁻⁸，在常见 FP16 范围内可能下溢。若损失先乘 1024，梯度也乘同一倍数；反传后再除 1024，才恢复原更新尺度。缩放不能修复中间激活溢出，溢出时还需跳过更新并调整策略。

depth.boundary: Unscaling and optimizer updates must occur at the correct accumulation boundaries.

introduction.definition: 单调队列保留窗口内可能成为最大值的候选，让滑动窗口最大值可线性计算。

exercise.question: 队尾更小元素为什么可以删？
exercise.answer: 新元素更大且更晚过期，小元素再也不能成为未来窗口最大值。

derivation: 队列存下标，值从头到尾不增；队头过期时删除。
每个下标最多入队一次、出队一次，全部操作O(n)。

steps: 读1后候选[1]；读3删除1得到[3]；读2得到[3,2]，首窗最大3。
读5删2和3得[5]，第二窗最大5，输出[3,5]。
calculation.result: 读5删2和3得[5]，第二窗最大5，输出[3,5]。

application.scenario: 监测最近60秒请求延迟的最大值。
steps: 按时间戳删除过期队头，按延迟删除被新值支配的队尾。
队头始终给出当前时间窗口最大值，不需重扫全部请求。
application.result: 队头始终给出当前时间窗口最大值，不需重扫全部请求。

transfer.question: 窗口长度改1，输出如何？
steps: 每个旧下标在下一个到来时立即过期。
每窗只有自身，输出[1,3,2,5]。
transfer.answer: 每窗只有自身，输出[1,3,2,5]。

blocks.text: For a sliding-window maximum, a deque stores indices in nonincreasing order of their values. When a new value arrives, remove indices from the back while their values are no greater: the new value is at least as large and expires later. Remove the front index when it leaves the window. The remaining front gives the current maximum.

For example, the window sweeps through one, three, and two. When three enters, one can be eliminated, but two cannot eliminate three. Each index can enter and exit the queue once at most, so the amortized time is linear. Use a queue that supports constant-time operations on both ends; deleting the head of an ordinary array in some languages will move elements, and it cannot be claimed that the implementation is still linear.

depth.boundary: This differs from a monotonic stack. Linear-time array-front deletion can degrade the implementation.

introduction.definition: 单调栈保存尚未找到答案的元素，用新元素一次解决一批“下一个更大值”问题。
introduction.example: 数组[2,1,3]，找右侧第一个更大元素。

exercise.question: 为2找到更大值3后还要继续搜索吗？
exercise.answer: 不用，按顺序扫描保证这是第一个。

derivation: 栈内值保持不增，新值更大时不断弹出并赋答案。
每个下标只入出一次，总时间O(n)，未弹出的元素无更大后继。

calculation.scenario: 数组[2,1,3]，找右侧第一个更大元素。
steps: 遇3依次弹1、2并赋3，最终答案[3,3,无]。
calculation.result: 遇3依次弹1、2并赋3，最终答案[3,3,无]。

application.scenario: 计算每天要等多久才遇到更暖天气。
steps: 栈存天数下标，遇更高温时用当前下标减被弹下标。
得等待天数，留栈者按约定填0。
application.result: 得等待天数，留栈者按约定填0。

transfer.question: 若数组为[2,2,3]，比较符号用大于还是大于等于？
steps: 题目要求严格更大，第二个2不能解决第一个2。
只在新值严格大于栈顶时弹，两个2都由3解决。
transfer.answer: 只在新值严格大于栈顶时弹，两个2都由3解决。

blocks.text: Daily Temperatures maintains a stack of indices with nonincreasing temperatures. When a warmer temperature arrives, repeatedly pop indices; the difference between the current index and the popped index is the waiting time. The stack contains positions whose answers are unresolved, and popped positions need no further work. Each index is pushed and popped once, giving linear total work by amortized analysis. Equal temperature is not warmer, so it must not resolve an earlier position.

worked.title: Monotonic Stack: Resolve Waiting Time When Popping
worked.scenario: For temperatures [20,24,22,27,21], find how many days each position waits for a warmer day. The stack stores indices whose answers are unresolved.
steps: Day 1 has temperature 24, warmer than day 0 at 20. Pop index 0 and set its answer to 1.
Day 2 at 22 is not warmer than 24, so push it. Day 3 at 27 first pops index 2 and records 1, then pops index 1 and records 2.
Indices 3 and 4 have no later warmer day, so their answers remain 0.
worked.result: Waiting times are [1,2,1,0,0]. Each index is pushed and popped at most once: time O(n), auxiliary space O(n).
worked.pitfall: The task requires a strictly warmer day, so equal temperatures do not resolve an answer. Store indices, not only values, to calculate distances.
worked.question: What changes for [20,20,21]?
worked.answer: The result is [2,1,0]. The second 20 does not pop the first 20.

depth.boundary: Linear total work follows because each item enters and leaves at most once. Specify comparisons for equal values.

introduction.definition: MSE平均平方误差，MAE平均绝对误差，RMSE把MSE开方恢复目标单位。
introduction.example: 两个预测误差为1和3。

exercise.question: RMSE一定等于MAE吗？
exercise.answer: 不等，此例分别约2.236和2。

derivation: 平方误差放大大误差影响，绝对误差线性增长。
MSE最优常对应条件均值，MAE最优常对应条件中位数。

calculation.scenario: 两个预测误差为1和3。
steps: RMSE=√5≈2.236，单位与原目标相同。
calculation.result: RMSE=√5≈2.236，单位与原目标相同。

application.scenario: 比较房价回归模型。
steps: 同时报告MAE与RMSE，并明确价格单位、异常值及是否在对数尺度计算。
RMSE偏高提示大误差影响强，可进一步检查尾部样本。
application.result: RMSE偏高提示大误差影响强，可进一步检查尾部样本。

transfer.question: 若把误差3改30，变化怎样？
steps: RMSE≈21.225，大误差使平方指标上升更明显。
transfer.answer: RMSE≈21.225，大误差使平方指标上升更明显。

blocks.text: MSE, mean squared error, is common in continuous-value prediction and penalizes large errors strongly. MAE, mean absolute error, measures the magnitude of deviations from the true value and is less sensitive to extreme errors. RMSE is the square root of MSE and has the same units as the target. For temperature predictions, an error in degrees is easier to interpret than one in squared degrees. These losses and metrics can be used with other suitable models, not only linear regression.
例子：两笔预测误差为 1、−3，MSE=(1²+3²)/2=5，MAE=(1+3)/2=2，RMSE=√5≈2.236。RMSE 与目标同单位，MSE 的单位是目标单位的平方；不能跨不同目标尺度直接比较它们的数值。

depth.boundary: Account for the target’s units and the different penalties on large errors when choosing or comparing these measures.

applications.title: Brier Score · 金融二元概率的平方评分
applications.reason: 均方误差的定义复用共同基础；这里规定概率预测与二元金融标签的评分对象。

concepts.title: Multi-source BFS · 等时传播与最近源距离

introduction.definition: 多源BFS同时从多个起点扩散，计算每个点离最近起点的无权距离。
introduction.example: 一条线的5个格子0至4，起点为0和4。

exercise.question: 要分别跑两次再取最小吗？
exercise.answer: 不必，把全部起点以距离0一起入队即可。

derivation: BFS按层推进，任一起点首次到达的距离就是所有起点中的最小值。
统一访问标记避免重复扩散，队列工作仍为O(V+E)。

calculation.scenario: 一条线的5个格子0至4，起点为0和4。
steps: 初始化距离[0,∞,∞,∞,0]，第一层使1与3为1。

application.scenario: 地图上查询最近医院的步行格数。
steps: 所有医院格子入队为0，墙壁不参与扩散。
一次计算后每个可达格子都能直接读取最近医院距离。
application.result: 一次计算后每个可达格子都能直接读取最近医院距离。

transfer.question: 若起点0与4的启动时间分别0与5，还能都设0吗？
steps: 不能，不同初始时间破坏统一距离层。
应按初始时间做最短路；此例到4最早为从0走4步的时间4，而非5。
transfer.answer: 应按初始时间做最短路；此例到4最早为从0走4步的时间4，而非5。

blocks.text: 多源 BFS 把多个起点同时置为距离零，再按普通 BFS 扩展。它求等权图中每个可达节点到最近起点的最短距离，适合同时发生的传播或多个服务点的最近距离；不是从每个源分别重复整次搜索。
对起点集合 S，\(d(v)=\min_{s\in S}\operatorname{dist}(s,v)\)。先把 S 中所有节点入队，并在首次入队时标记已发现，再向未发现邻居赋 d+1。邻接表实现的时间为 O(V+E)，辅助存储为 O(V)。若边耗时不同，层数不能直接当经过时间。
一条五格通道的两端同时开始传播，初始队列含位置 0 和 4，距离依次为 (0,1,2,1,0)。只先完成左端的 BFS 再处理右端，会破坏“所有源同时开始”的初始化含义。若某格被障碍完全隔离，应保留不可达状态，不能把它当作零分钟到达。

depth.boundary: With unequal edge travel times, layer count need not equal shortest travel time.

introduction.definition: NaN是无定义数值，Inf是无穷或溢出，OOM是内存不足；三者原因与处理不同。
introduction.example: float32张量形状(1000,1000)，只算数据占用。

exercise.question: OOM能靠把NaN替换为0解决吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，OOM是资源问题，不是非法数值问题。

derivation: 0/0会产生NaN，有限精度中超范围运算可能得到Inf。
内存由元素数、类型及保存状态共同决定，需定位首个异常或分配失败。

calculation.scenario: float32张量形状(1000,1000)，只算数据占用。
steps: 数据约400万字节；再保存同大梯度会额外约400万，不含其他状态。
calculation.result: 数据约400万字节；再保存同大梯度会额外约400万，不含其他状态。

application.scenario: 训练突然停止。
steps: 检查异常类型：数值异常追首个非有限算子，OOM则记录峰值、批大小和保留图。
先修根因，再验证有限损失及显存，不能盲目吞掉异常继续。
application.result: 先修根因，再验证有限损失及显存，不能盲目吞掉异常继续。

transfer.question: 若批大小减半，所有显存都会减半吗？
steps: 激活常随批大小下降，但参数与优化器状态通常不变。
若固定状态8 GB、激活4 GB，激活减半后共10 GB，而非6 GB。
transfer.answer: 若固定状态8 GB、激活4 GB，激活减半后共10 GB，而非6 GB。

blocks.text: Loss scaling amplifies the loss in some mixed-precision training so that small gradients remain representable, then compensates before updating. NaN denotes an invalid numeric value; Inf denotes infinity, for example after overflow. These can arise from division by zero, extreme scores or unstable operations. OOM means out of memory, not exploding gradients. For OOM, inspect batch size, sequence length, saved activations and model size. For NaN, inspect numerical values and data first.

depth.boundary: Separate numerical diagnosis from memory diagnosis first.

introduction.definition: 离策略学习可使用不同策略收集的数据；离线强化学习只用固定数据集，不再与环境交互。
introduction.example: 数据只含状态s下动作A，平均回报2，从未尝试B。

exercise.question: 离线算法估计B价值10足以推荐B吗？
exercise.answer: 不够，缺乏覆盖时高值可能是外推误差。

derivation: 离策略更新需要处理行为分布与目标策略分布的差异。
离线不能采样纠正未知区域，因此常限制策略偏离数据或保守估值。

calculation.scenario: 数据只含状态s下动作A，平均回报2，从未尝试B。
steps: B样本数0，无法仅凭这批数据直接算出可靠经验均值。
calculation.result: B样本数0，无法仅凭这批数据直接算出可靠经验均值。

application.scenario: 从历史推荐日志学习策略。
steps: 检查动作覆盖与日志策略，按用户或时间切分并做合适离线评估。
对未覆盖动作保持谨慎，并在获授权的小流量验证后再扩大。
application.result: 对未覆盖动作保持谨慎，并在获授权的小流量验证后再扩大。

transfer.question: 若重新允许采样B，还是严格离线学习吗？
steps: 不再满足固定数据、无环境交互的条件。
可进入在线或离线到在线阶段，用新观察纠正B估值。
transfer.answer: 可进入在线或离线到在线阶段，用新观察纠正B估值。

blocks.text: Offline RL trains on a fixed collection of interactions without gathering new experience from the environment during training. It can overestimate actions poorly covered by the dataset. CQL addresses this with conservative value estimation; IQL fits values and extracts a policy while limiting dependence on evaluating actions outside the data. Neither creates missing coverage. Offline evaluation is also an imperfect substitute for safe, controlled real-world validation.
例子：日志只记录在某状态选择“等待”，从未记录“大额买入”。离线算法即使给后者估出高价值，也缺少相应数据支持；在仿真里选择它不等于已验证真实成交。off-policy 指学习目标策略可不同于采样策略，offline 另强调训练期间不再收集新交互。

depth.boundary: An off-policy algorithm can also collect new experience continuously online.

introduction.definition: 参数由训练数据学出；超参数控制模型结构与训练过程，通常通过验证选择。
introduction.example: 线性模型y=wx+b，当前w=2、b=1，学习率0.1。

exercise.question: 学习率与w都由普通梯度更新自动改变吗？
exercise.answer: 通常只更新w、b；学习率由配置或调度决定。

derivation: 损失对模型参数求导，优化器使用超参数决定如何应用梯度。
超参数选择也会过拟合验证集，因此最终测试仍需独立。

calculation.scenario: 线性模型y=wx+b，当前w=2、b=1，学习率0.1。
steps: 若学习率改0.01，同一梯度得到1.97，超参数改变了更新幅度。
calculation.result: 若学习率改0.01，同一梯度得到1.97，超参数改变了更新幅度。

application.scenario: 选择神经网络隐藏层宽度。
steps: 宽度作为候选超参数，各自完整训练权重。
按验证表现与资源成本选配置，再锁定并测试。
application.result: 按验证表现与资源成本选配置，再锁定并测试。

transfer.question: 调度器让学习率每步变化，它就成为模型参数了吗？
steps: 不一定，变化本身不是区分标准。
若由预设规则决定，仍是训练控制量；元学习可另行把它设成可学习量。
transfer.answer: 若由预设规则决定，仍是训练控制量；元学习可另行把它设成可学习量。

blocks.text: Weights and biases are learnable model values; “parameter” is the general category. Learning rate, batch size, and maximum tree depth are usually hyperparameters controlling the model or training, rather than weights directly fitted by ordinary training. A bias term is not the statistical bias in the bias–variance tradeoff or social bias. The same word has different meanings: first determine whether the discussion concerns model structure, statistical error, or fairness.
例子：回归模型 ŷ=wx+b，拟合得到 w=2、b=1，这是参数。学习率 0.01、正则强度 0.1 是选择训练程序的超参数，应在验证流程中选择；不能反复看最终测试误差调到最好，再把它当独立测试成绩。

blocks.text: 主成分分析（PCA）把中心化后的多变量数据投影到彼此正交、按方差大小排序的方向。它是无监督降维：只看输入的变化，不保证保留的方向最能预测标签。
有 n 行样本、d 列特征的中心化矩阵 X，样本协方差为 $\Sigma=X^\top X/(n-1)$。求 $\Sigma v_j=\lambda_jv_j$，按特征值 λ 降序选择 k 个单位正交向量组成 V，投影为 $Z=XV$。第 j 个方向的解释方差比为 $\lambda_j/\sum_l\lambda_l$。中心和可选的尺度参数必须只在训练集拟合。
协方差矩阵 [[2,1],[1,2]] 的特征值为 3、1，第一方向为 (1,1)/√2，保留一个方向解释 75% 方差。中心化样本 (2,0) 在这一方向的坐标为 √2；标签若取决于另一方向，压缩仍可能丢失预测信息。

blocks.text: PID adjusts control using current error, accumulated error and the rate of error change to track a desired state. The proportional term responds to deviation, the integral term handles persistent offset, and the derivative term can provide damping. Noise, delay and tuning affect stability. PID is not learned from large video datasets, but is useful in many stabilization tasks.

worked.title: World Models: Prediction Error and Feedback Correction
worked.scenario: One-dimensional position x starts at 0 and targets 5. The real system follows x_next=x+u+wind, while the predictor ignores wind. Actions are restricted to [-1,1].
steps: A fixed-action policy always uses u=1. With wind=-0.3, each real movement is only 0.7, so predictions and observations diverge.
A feedback policy observes again each step and uses u=clip(5-x,-1,1). Its action shrinks as it approaches the target.
With wind=-0.3, feedback settles near 4.7, retaining a steady-state offset. Fixed actions continue past the target.
worked.result: Closed-loop feedback changes accumulated error, but a proportional policy without wind compensation cannot eliminate every offset. The demo shows predicted and actual next positions together.
worked.pitfall: This is not full MPC: it neither optimizes a multistep action sequence nor trains a world model. The simplified dynamics illustrate prediction, observation and feedback.
worked.question: With zero wind, what happens after the feedback policy reaches 5?
worked.answer: Its action becomes 0 and position remains 5. The fixed-action policy keeps moving by 1 each step.

depth.boundary: The prediction horizon may differ from the executed horizon.

concepts.title: Postorder DP · 树上动态规划的返回值与全局答案

introduction.definition: 后序树形动态规划先算子树，再把子树答案合并成父节点答案。

derivation: 定义size[u]=1+Σsize[child]，叶子没有孩子所以为1。
后序确保合并时孩子答案已完整，树中每条边只参与有限次。

再得size[R]=1+1+1=3，总处理3个节点。

blocks.text: 后序树形动态规划先求子树摘要，再合成当前节点的结果。它把动态规划用于树结构；递归只负责遍历顺序，状态的含义和能否向父节点延伸仍须单独定义。树高、直径、最大路径和可以采用相近遍历，却不能混用返回值。
以节点数定义高度，空树 h=0，节点高度为 \(h(u)=1+\max(h_l,h_r)\)。若直径按边数计，经过当前节点的候选为 h_l+h_r。最大路径和中，返回父节点的增益只能选一侧；更新全局答案时才允许左右两侧同时接入。每个节点处理一次，时间为 O(n)，递归栈空间取决于树高。
根节点的左右孩子都为叶子，左右高度均为 1，根高度为 2，直径是 2 条边。若计算最大路径和且整棵树只有值 −3 的节点，答案应是 −3；把全局答案初始化为 0 会错误地选择一条题目未允许的空路径。

depth.boundary: A one-sided path passed upward differs from a candidate joining both sides at the current node.

introduction.definition: PPO限制策略一次变化；SAC加入熵鼓励探索；TD3用双价值估计等措施改善连续动作学习。

exercise.answer: 不能，要匹配动作空间、采样方式与训练设定。

SAC优化奖励加熵；TD3常取双critic较小值减轻高估，并延迟策略更新。

calculation.scenario: PPO旧动作概率0.2、新概率0.3，优势1，裁剪范围0.8至1.2。
steps: 裁剪为1.2，取min(1.5,1.2)=1.2；这不是把真实策略概率硬截为0.24。
calculation.result: 裁剪为1.2，取min(1.5,1.2)=1.2；这不是把真实策略概率硬截为0.24。

steps: 可评估复用回放数据的SAC或TD3，与适合现有采样流程的PPO比较。
统一环境步数、种子与评估协议，避免只按一次最好回报选算法。

transfer.answer: 若即时奖励1、折扣0.9且非终止，目标为1+0.9×5=5.5。

blocks.text: TRPO uses a trust-region approach to constrain policy changes and avoid destroying existing behavior in one update. PPO pursues similar stability through easier-to-implement objectives, such as clipping or penalties. It commonly performs several updates on a newly collected batch of interactions before gathering fresh data. PPO controls update incentives; it does not enforce the same maximum change on every parameter or guarantee that a policy never moves too far.
例子：PPO 的一次样本优势为 +1，新旧动作概率比为 1.3，裁剪 ε=0.2，则该样本的裁剪目标取 min(1.3,1.2)=1.2。SAC 的熵奖励和 TD3 的双评论家、延迟更新解决的是不同机制，不能用同一裁剪式概括全部算法。

depth.boundary: Clipping the PPO objective differs from clipping gradients and does not impose a hard bound on every policy change.

introduction.definition: 查准率问：被报为正的样本中，有多少真的为正。

exercise.answer: 不会，分母只统计所有报警，即TP+FP。

derivation: P=TP/(TP+FP)，误报越多，在TP不变时比例越低。
阈值变化会改变被报为正的集合，因此查准率需连同阈值报告。

calculation.scenario: 报警10次，其中8次是真问题。
steps: 误报增至4且TP不变，P=8/12≈0.6667。
calculation.result: 误报增至4且TP不变，P=8/12≈0.6667。

transfer.question: 若模型从不报警，查准率是100%吗？
steps: 此时TP+FP=0，原公式未定义。
按约定报告未定义或指定值，并明确无报警，不能直接宣称完美。
transfer.answer: 按约定报告未定义或指定值，并明确无报警，不能直接宣称完美。

blocks.text: Precision is the fraction of predicted positives that are actually positive. It answers whether positive predictions are trustworthy at a specified decision threshold.

Precision=TP/(TP+FP), where TP counts correctly predicted positives and FP counts negative examples predicted positive. If no positive predictions exist, the denominator is zero and the evaluation convention must be stated.
A detector raises 10 alarms and 8 are true cases: precision is 80%. This does not tell how many true cases it missed; recall addresses that separate denominator.

depth.boundary: The denominator counts predicted positives, not actual positives. Precision is undefined when no examples are predicted positive unless a reporting convention is specified.

introduction.definition: 前缀和保存从开头到各位置的累计和，让连续区间求和只需相减。

exercise.answer: 使从第0项开始的区间也能使用同一减法公式。

derivation: 区间[l,r)之和P[r]−P[l]，共同前缀恰好抵消。

calculation.scenario: 数组[2,1,4]，用半开区间求下标1至3的和。

若原数据频繁修改，应评估树状数组等动态结构，静态前缀更新会影响后缀。

新[1,3)和9−2=7；旧前缀会错误返回5。

blocks.text: Define the prefix sum P such that the sum of the first zero elements is zero. The sum of a segment is k, which is equivalent to the current prefix sum minus an earlier prefix sum equal to k. Therefore, when scanning the current prefix P, check how many times P minus k has appeared before, then accumulate the answer, and finally record the current P. The occurrence of the zero prefix must be recorded once at the beginning to count the interval starting from the beginning of the array.

For example, one, negative one, one, the target is one. The three legal intervals come from two single elements and the entire array; the prefix frequency can count the contribution of repeated prefixes. The hash table must save the number of times, not just whether it exists. Recording the current prefix first and then querying will incorrectly include empty intervals when k is zero.

worked.title: Prefix Sums: Counting Still Works with Negative Numbers
worked.scenario: For [1,-1,1], count contiguous subarrays whose sum is 1. Let s be the prefix sum and initialize its frequency table to {0:1}.
steps: After the first element, s=1. Look up s-1=0 and find one prior prefix. Add 1 to the count, then record prefix sum 1.
After the second element, s=0. Looking up -1 finds no prefix. Increase the frequency of prefix sum 0 to 2.
After the third element, s=1. Looking up 0 finds two prior prefixes, raising the total count to 3. Then record the current prefix.
worked.result: The three index intervals are [0,0], [0,2] and [2,2]. Expected time O(n), auxiliary space O(n).
worked.pitfall: Query before recording the current prefix; otherwise a target of 0 counts an empty interval. With negative values, window sums need not change monotonically as the window grows.
worked.question: How many nonempty zero-sum intervals does [0,0,0] contain?
worked.answer: 6: three of length 1, two of length 2 and one of length 3. Prefix frequencies contribute 1+2+3.

worked.title: Difference Arrays: Undo the Increment After the Range
worked.scenario: Start with a zero-based, length-5 array of zeros. Add 2 to inclusive [1,3], then add -1 to [2,4], reconstructing the array afterward.
steps: Allocate a length-6 difference array. The first update adds 2 to d[1] and subtracts 2 from d[4].
The second subtracts 1 from d[2] and adds 1 to d[5]. Position d[5] is a sentinel canceling the update after the array ends.
Prefix-sum the first five differences to obtain values 0,2,1,1,-1 at positions 0…4.
worked.result: The final array is [0,2,1,1,-1]. Each range update changes two endpoints; final reconstruction takes O(n).
worked.pitfall: For an inclusive range, cancel at r+1 rather than r. Allocate the sentinel but do not return it as a sixth array value.
worked.question: For a half-open range [l,r), where is the cancellation?
worked.answer: At d[r], because r is already outside the updated range.

depth.boundary: Counting often needs prefix frequencies and an initial zero prefix. Tree paths also need state undo on return.

introduction.definition: Q-learning按下一状态最优动作估值更新；SARSA按实际下一动作更新。

exercise.question: 两个方法的目标总是一样吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，实际下一动作并非最优时会不同。

SARSA目标r+γQ(s′,a′)，反映执行中的策略，包括探索。

calculation.scenario: 奖励1，折扣0.9，下一动作价值为2与5，实际选价值2的动作。

SARSA目标1+0.9×2=2.8，终止状态通常不再自举。
calculation.result: SARSA目标1+0.9×2=2.8，终止状态通常不再自举。

steps: SARSA把探索时实际动作风险纳入估值，Q-learning则估计贪心后续。
统一探索率比较真实回报，不能仅比较表中最大Q。

transfer.question: 若当前Q=1、学习率0.5，按Q-learning目标更新多少？

blocks.text: Classic Q-learning uses the estimated value of the best next-state action in its target, even when exploration actually selects another action. SARSA uses the value of the action actually selected next under the behavior policy. This illustrates off-policy versus on-policy learning: the relationship between the target policy and the policy collecting data. Off-policy does not mean offline; an off-policy algorithm can collect new data while learning.

worked.title: Q-Learning: No Bootstrapping at True Termination
worked.scenario: Current Q(s,a)=2, reward r=1, maximum next-state Q=4, discount γ=0.9 and learning rate α=0.5.
steps: For a nonterminal transition, the target is r+γ max Q=1+0.9×4=4.6.
The TD error is 4.6-2=2.6. Update Q=2+0.5×2.6=3.3.
At a true terminal state, the target is only r=1, giving 2+0.5×(1-2)=1.5.
worked.result: The same observed reward produces different learning targets depending on termination. One tabular Q-learning update does not establish a fully learned policy.
worked.pitfall: Distinguish true termination from time-limit truncation. Bootstrapping depends on the task and interface semantics. Q-learning uses the maximum next-state value; SARSA uses the actual next action’s value.
worked.question: With α=1, what is the updated value for the nonterminal transition?
worked.answer: It becomes the current target, 4.6. This does not mean the target estimate is noise-free.

depth.boundary: They relate the behavior policy and target policy differently.

随机枢轴通常有期望O(n)，不良划分可退化O(n²)。

steps: 以3为枢轴得到小侧[1,2]、等侧[3]、大侧[4]。
第2小位于小侧，再划分得到2，不必排序整个数组。

若流式输入需固定内存，可改用容量100的小顶堆。

steps: 三路划分给出相等区[2,2,2]，覆盖排名1至3。
目标落在等区，直接返回2，不再递归相同区间。

blocks.text: If you want to find the kth largest value, you don't have to sort the entire array. Maintain a min-heap with a size of at most k. The top of the heap is the minimum value among the current retainers, which is the elimination threshold. It is worth replacing only if the new value exceeds the threshold. After scanning, the top of the heap will be the kth largest. The frequencies of the top k high-frequency elements are first counted, and then the same selection is made according to the frequency. The ranking object changes from the numerical value to the frequency of the key.

The heap only guarantees the extreme value at the top of the heap, and does not guarantee the overall ordering of the internal array. Here, the kth largest number of elements is counted, and repeated values still account for multiple rankings; the top k high-frequency objects are different keys and must be distinguished.

worked.title: Top K: Let Requirements Determine the Algorithm
worked.scenario: Find the two largest values in [9,1,7,3,8]. First clarify whether output must be ordered, input may be modified, and data arrives continuously.
steps: Keep a min-heap of size 2, whose root is the current second-largest value. Reading 9 and 1 gives {1,9}; 7 replaces 1, 3 is ignored, and 8 replaces 7.
The retained values are {8,9}. Descending output still requires sorting those two results.
A static array can instead use quickselect to find the boundary in average O(n) time. It rearranges the array, leaves the selected region unsorted, and its worst case depends on pivot selection.
worked.result: A heap suits streaming updates: time O(n log k), auxiliary space O(k). Quickselect suits mutable static data. The constraints determine the choice.
worked.pitfall: “Quickselect is faster than sorting” is incomplete without average versus worst-case cost, output ordering and input mutation requirements.
worked.question: Data keeps arriving and Top K must be available at any time. What should be considered first?
worked.answer: A fixed-size heap is usually convenient for incremental maintenance. Also discuss costs when k is close to n and the overhead of returning sorted results.

depth.boundary: Quickselect usually modifies input. Randomized versions have expected linear but worst-case quadratic time.

introduction.definition: 检索增强生成先取相关资料，再让模型依据资料回答问题。
introduction.example: 知识库查到政策段落写明“退款期限7天”。

exercise.question: 检索到了资料就保证回答正确吗？
exercise.answer: 不保证，检索可能过期、遗漏，生成也可能误读。

derivation: 查询先编码检索候选，再重排和裁剪上下文，最后生成带依据的回答。

calculation.scenario: 知识库查到政策段落写明“退款期限7天”。
steps: 标注10题，其中8题检到正确依据，检索召回8/10=0.8。
其中6题最终答对，整体正确率6/10=0.6，不能用0.8冒充答案正确率。
calculation.result: 其中6题最终答对，整体正确率6/10=0.6，不能用0.8冒充答案正确率。

application.scenario: 回答公司内部报销规则。
steps: 检索仅用户可访问的当前版本，保留段落来源与生效日期。
上下文写明7天就引用该条；冲突或无依据时说明资料不足。
application.result: 上下文写明7天就引用该条；冲突或无依据时说明资料不足。

blocks.text: RAG, retrieval-augmented generation, retrieves relevant information from external documents or knowledge bases before answering, and supplies it to an LLM. It addresses stale parameter knowledge, private organizational knowledge absent from training, and answers that require clear evidence. RAG can reduce some knowledge hallucinations but cannot guarantee every answer is correct.

Keep three roles distinct. An LLM supplies language and reasoning capabilities. RAG supplies external knowledge. An agent system uses models, tools and workflows to perform tasks. These can work together, but describe different parts of a system.

worked.title: RRF: Fuse Ranks Instead of Adding Raw Scores
worked.scenario: Keyword retrieval ranks A,B,C; vector retrieval ranks C,B,D. A document contributes 1/(k+rank) from each list, with ranks starting at 1.
steps: At k=60, A receives 1/61 and D receives 1/63. B receives 2/62.
C receives 1/63+1/61≈0.032266, slightly above B≈0.032258.
Merge all documents that appear and sort by the fused score. A document absent from a list contributes 0 from that list.
worked.result: The final order is C,B,A,D. Rank fusion avoids directly adding BM25 raw scores and similarity scores on different scales.
worked.pitfall: RRF scores are not probabilities. Deduplicate each retrieval list first. The parameter k is not the number of results returned.
worked.question: What happens if only one retrieval list remains?
worked.answer: The fused order matches that list, because 1/(k+rank) decreases as rank increases.

depth.boundary: Retrieval does not guarantee a correct answer or sufficient evidence.

introduction.definition: 随机森林训练多棵带随机性的树，再汇总预测，降低单棵树的不稳定。
introduction.example: 三棵分类树输出[猫,狗,狗]。

exercise.question: 森林每棵树应完全相同吗？
exercise.answer: 不应，样本重采样和分裂特征随机性提供差异。

derivation: 不同树误差不完全相关时，平均可降低方差。
树之间过度相关会限制收益，增加棵数不能消除所有偏差。

calculation.scenario: 三棵分类树输出[猫,狗,狗]。
steps: 硬投票中狗2票、猫1票，结果狗。

application.scenario: 为表格分类构建稳健基线。
steps: 调整树数、深度、叶子样本数并使用适当验证切分。
检查逐类表现与袋外评估，特征重要性需警惕相关特征与高基数偏差。
application.result: 检查逐类表现与袋外评估，特征重要性需警惕相关特征与高基数偏差。

transfer.question: 若100棵树总预测相同错误，多数投票能修正吗？
steps: 100票都支持同一错误类别。
仍然错误，独立性与数据质量比单纯增加树数更重要。
transfer.answer: 仍然错误，独立性与数据质量比单纯增加树数更重要。

blocks.text: Random forests predict with many trees. Classic training gives each tree a different bootstrap sample and limits each split to a random feature subset. This second randomness is crucial: if one strong feature always dominates the top split, trees become similar; limiting candidates lets them explore different rules.

Regression usually averages tree values; classification may vote or average class probabilities depending on implementation. Different perspectives reduce a single tree's high variance. They cannot recover information every tree lacks, nor guarantee freedom from overfitting.

worked.title: Random Forests: Error Correlation Limits Voting Gains
worked.scenario: Five classification trees vote [1,1,0,1,0] on one email. Positive means spam.
steps: Hard voting gives 3 to 2, producing class 1. Trees using identical data and features may make highly correlated errors.
For each tree, draw a bootstrap sample of training observations with replacement. Randomly selecting candidate features at each split introduces further variation among trees.
If all five trees make the same error on a type of email, adding votes does not automatically correct that systematic bias.
worked.result: An ensemble requires useful individual predictors and is also affected by error correlation. Real random forest classifiers may average leaf probabilities, unlike this hard-voting example.
worked.pitfall: 3/5 is not automatically a calibrated real-world probability. Out-of-bag evaluation does not replace independent testing for every task.
worked.question: Every tree predicts 0 when the truth is 1. Would adding 100 identical trees help?
worked.answer: No. Duplicating the same error adds no information.

depth.boundary: Random forests mainly reduce variance; they do not guarantee freedom from overfitting.

introduction.definition: 查全率问：所有真实正例中，有多少被找出来。
introduction.example: 真实问题10个，报警找到7个，漏掉3个。

exercise.question: 增加很多误报会直接降低召回吗？
exercise.answer: 不会直接进入公式，但会提高处理成本。

derivation: R=TP/(TP+FN)，分母是实际正例总数。
在TP不变时减少漏报会提高召回，阈值降低通常同时增加误报。

calculation.scenario: 真实问题10个，报警找到7个，漏掉3个。
steps: 若再找到2个漏报，TP=9、FN=1，R=0.9。
calculation.result: 若再找到2个漏报，TP=9、FN=1，R=0.9。

application.scenario: 疾病筛查优先降低漏诊。
steps: 在独立验证集选满足召回要求的阈值，并给出置信区间与误报量。

application.result: 核查重要亚组召回，不能用整体高值掩盖某群体漏诊。

transfer.question: 若对所有人都报阳，召回与查准率如何？
steps: 所有真实正例被找到，召回为1。
若100人中10人真阳，查准率10/100=0.1，说明高召回不代表高精度。
transfer.answer: 若100人中10人真阳，查准率10/100=0.1，说明高召回不代表高精度。

blocks.text: Recall is the fraction of actual positive cases identified by a classifier. It measures coverage of positives at a specified decision threshold.
Recall=TP/(TP+FN), where FN counts positive examples missed by the classifier. If there are no actual positives, this ratio is undefined without an explicit reporting convention.
If a dataset contains 20 true cases and the detector finds 8, recall is 40%. The number of false alarms can change precision without changing this recall value.

depth.boundary: Improving recall does not mean false positives are necessarily acceptable.

introduction.definition: 正则化通过限制模型或增加惩罚，减少对训练噪声的过度拟合。
introduction.example: 数据损失1，参数w=2，目标增加λw²/2，λ=0.1。

exercise.question: 正则越强一定越好吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，过强会使模型欠拟合。

derivation: 总目标J=L+λR，参数更新同时考虑数据与复杂度约束。
以L2为例，惩罚梯度λw把权重向0拉，但不保证稀疏。

calculation.scenario: 数据损失1，参数w=2，目标增加λw²/2，λ=0.1。
steps: 附加梯度0.1×2=0.2，学习率0.1时单独使w减少0.02。
calculation.result: 附加梯度0.1×2=0.2，学习率0.1时单独使w减少0.02。

application.scenario: 高维小样本回归。
steps: 仅在训练拟合参数，用验证集比较多个正则强度。
报告训练与验证误差差距，确认没有因抑制过强损害两者。
application.result: 报告训练与验证误差差距，确认没有因抑制过强损害两者。

transfer.question: 若λ从0.1变1，惩罚梯度多少？
steps: 同学习率附加更新0.2，强度增10倍，需要重新验证拟合与泛化。
transfer.answer: 同学习率附加更新0.2，强度增10倍，需要重新验证拟合与泛化。

blocks.text: 正则化通过限制模型复杂度、约束参数或改变训练过程，降低对有限训练样本偶然特征的依赖。它通常引入偏差以换取更稳定的泛化，不保证在每个测试集上改善。Dropout 的机制与例子集中在独立方法页。
参数惩罚的一种形式为 $J(\theta)=L_{\mathrm{train}}(\theta)+\lambda R(\theta)$，L 为训练损失，R 为复杂度惩罚，λ≥0 为强度。L2 惩罚常取参数平方和，L1 常取绝对值和；惩罚是否含偏置、是否除样本数须注明。
若训练损失为 3，单个权重 w=2，R=w²、λ=0.1，则总目标为 3.4。把 w 缩小虽降低惩罚，也可能增加拟合误差；需要优化完整目标，并在独立验证数据上选择 λ，而不是只追求更小权重。

depth.boundary: Excessive regularization can suppress real signal.

introduction.definition: 复制把相同数据保存多份以提高可用性；分片把不同数据分到不同节点以扩容。

复制不自动解决跨片事务，分片也不自动提供副本容错。

calculation.result: 每片物理150 GB，两片共300 GB，不含索引与日志。

steps: 按合适键分片，检查热点和跨片查询，再为每片配置副本。
演练节点故障和重平衡，验证读写一致性约定。
application.result: 演练节点故障和重平衡，验证读写一致性约定。

transfer.question: 若90%请求落同一用户，按用户分片能均匀吗？
steps: 该用户始终路由到一个分片。
热点仍存在，需重新设计键、缓存或拆分该用户数据，不能只增加空闲分片。
transfer.answer: 热点仍存在，需重新设计键、缓存或拆分该用户数据，不能只增加空闲分片。

blocks.text: Replication stores copies of the same data on multiple nodes; sharding partitions different data across nodes. They solve different problems and can be used together. Replication supports availability and read capacity; sharding distributes storage and work.

With D bytes of logical data, S evenly sized shards and R copies of each shard, each shard contains about D/S logical bytes and total replicated storage is about RD, before indexes and overhead. A partition key decides which shard owns a record; replica consistency and failure recovery require separate rules.

A 900 GB dataset split into 3 shards has about 300 GB per shard. Keeping 2 copies of each shard uses about 1,800 GB in total. Adding replicas does not divide the logical dataset into smaller shards; adding shards does not by itself create failover copies.

depth.boundary: The number of copies and the way data is divided solve different problems.

introduction.definition: ROC曲线比较命中率与假阳率；PR曲线比较查准率与召回，类别稀少时更直观暴露误报代价。

exercise.question: ROC-AUC是某个固定阈值准确率吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，它总结跨阈值的排序表现。

derivation: 无并列时AUC等于随机正例分数超过随机负例的概率。
PR中的查准率还依赖类别基率，AP与梯形PR面积并非总是相同。

steps: 4对正负比较中0.9胜两次，0.4只胜0.1一次，共3胜。

application.scenario: 评估罕见欺诈检测。
steps: 同时报告ROC-AUC、明确计算方式的PR指标和部署阈值下的误报量。
保持测试基率贴近实际，避免抽样平衡后误解查准率。
application.result: 保持测试基率贴近实际，避免抽样平衡后误解查准率。

steps: 各正负对的大小关系不变。
AUC仍0.75，显示排序指标不验证概率校准。
transfer.answer: AUC仍0.75，显示排序指标不验证概率校准。

blocks.text: The ROC curve compares true positive and false positive rates across thresholds; its AUC summarizes ranking discrimination. The PR curve compares precision and recall, often revealing the burden of false positives more directly when positives are rare. A high ROC AUC does not guarantee adequate precision at a particular threshold. Average precision is a common PR summary measure, but may differ from trapezoidal integration of the curve. Confirm the exact definition when reporting results.
Result and explanation: With class imbalance, accuracy can hide important differences. A single confusion matrix does not determine full ROC AUC or PR AUC.
Pitfalls and limits: Do not substitute precision at one threshold for PR AUC, or infer a complete ranking absent from these counts.

worked.title: Imbalanced Evaluation: Two Very Different 99% Scores
worked.scenario: There are 1000 samples, of which 10 are positive. A model gives TP=5, FP=5, FN=5, TN=985.
steps: Predicting everything negative gives TN=990, FN=10 and the same 99% accuracy, but Recall=0.
The operating points share accuracy but differ in positive detections and false alarms requiring review. Choose using costs and thresholds.
worked.result: With class imbalance, accuracy can hide important differences. A single confusion matrix does not determine full ROC AUC or PR AUC.
worked.pitfall: Do not substitute precision at one threshold for PR AUC, or infer a complete ranking absent from these counts.
worked.question: Does raising the threshold always improve precision?
worked.answer: No. The predicted-positive set shrinks, so recall cannot rise, but the positive proportion among remaining predictions can increase or decrease.

depth.boundary: Average precision and trapezoidal area under a PR curve need not be identical.

blocks.text: A sample is one example, such as an order. A feature is information available for prediction, such as price or a user's previous view count. A label is a supervised answer, such as whether the order was later canceled. Target is a broader term for the value or content the model is trained to predict or reconstruct: a class, number, next text segment, or image. Labels need not be manually annotated: next-word prediction gets its answers from the text itself. Distinguish answers available during training from information available at prediction time. If an answer unavailable at prediction time enters the input during training or evaluation, it causes data leakage.

depth.boundary: Information unavailable at prediction time causes leakage if included among features.

calculation.result: 完成4步后0.025，恢复训练需还原调度计数。

blocks.text: A learning-rate scheduler specifies how the learning rate changes. Step decay reduces it at specified points; exponential decay reduces it proportionally; cosine annealing follows a smooth cosine curve. ReduceLROnPlateau monitors a metric and lowers the rate when improvement stalls. These rules respond to either a fixed schedule or observed performance. Choose with the total training duration and the need for finer updates near the end in mind.
例子：初始学习率 0.1，每完成两轮乘 0.5，则第 1–2 轮用 0.1、第 3–4 轮用 0.05。若调度器按优化器更新步数推进，梯度累积会改变每轮更新次数；需记录调用时点，不能把 epoch 与 step 混用。

depth.boundary: Specify whether the schedule advances with optimizer updates, iterations, epochs, or validation checks.

introduction.definition: SFT用示范答案监督微调；LoRA只训练低秩增量；QLoRA把冻结底座量化并训练适配器。

calculation.scenario: 一个100×100权重矩阵，LoRA秩r=4。
steps: 相对10000减少92%，但显存还包含冻结权重、激活与优化器，不能同样声称减少92%。

application.scenario: 为客服模型学习特定回复风格。

blocks.text: Pretraining learns general patterns from large-scale data. Continued pretraining applies similar objectives to an existing model, often with additional domain data. SFT uses input–expected-response pairs to shape task behavior. These stages can all update parameters but differ in data format and objective. Adding documents does not always require fine-tuning: retrieval can also supply frequently updated knowledge with citations.
例子：一个 1000×1000 的权重矩阵有一百万参数。秩 r=4 的 LoRA 增量用 1000×4 与 4×1000 两个因子，共 8000 个参数，不含其他可训练项。QLoRA 还量化冻结基座，SFT 则描述监督训练任务；三者不是同一分类维度。

introduction.definition: SGD沿批梯度下降；动量把历史方向保留下来，使持续一致的梯度累积作用。

参数θ←θ−ηv；不同库可能采用归一化或其他约定，需核对公式。

calculation.scenario: v初始0，连续梯度2、2，β=0.9，学习率0.1，采用v←βv+g。
steps: 首步v=2，更新幅度0.2。

steps: 用动量保留长期方向，配合学习率选择控制过冲。
记录训练与验证曲线，并在恢复时保存速度状态。

blocks.text: Full-batch gradient descent uses all training samples to compute an update direction. This gives a less noisy direction but is expensive for large datasets. Strictly, stochastic gradient descent can mean using one sample per update, although modern training commonly uses SGD to mean minibatch training. Minibatches give noisier directions but allow more frequent updates and hardware parallelism. Stochastic gradients are estimates from sampled data, not arbitrary changes to parameters.
例子：采用 v_t=0.9v_{t−1}+g_t，w_t=w_{t−1}−0.1v_t，初始 v=0、连续梯度都为 2，则 v 先为 2、再为 3.8，两次参数变化为 −0.2、−0.38。其他库可能把学习率纳入速度定义，比较公式时应核对约定。

depth.boundary: In modern use, SGD often means the minibatch version.

introduction.definition: Sigmoid把任意实数压到0与1之间，常将二分类分数解释为概率。
introduction.example: 输入z=ln3。

exercise.question: sigmoid(0)是0吗？

derivation: σ(z)=1/(1+exp(−z))，正分数越大越接近1。
导数σ(z)(1−σ(z))，两端饱和时很小。

calculation.scenario: 输入z=ln3。

训练若用BCEWithLogitsLoss则直接传分数，避免重复sigmoid。

transfer.question: 输入改为−ln3会怎样？

blocks.text: The sigmoid is a scalar function mapping any finite real score to a value strictly between zero and one. It is often used for binary labels or independently modeled multiple labels.

σ(z)=1/(1+exp(-z)), with derivative σ(z)(1-σ(z)). z is a raw score. Large positive or negative scores saturate the output near an endpoint; the transformation alone does not ensure well-calibrated probabilities.
At z=0, the output is 0.5. At z=log(3), it is 0.75. Applying sigmoid separately to two scores does not require their outputs to sum to one.

depth.boundary: Do not usually apply sigmoid before BCEWithLogitsLoss.

introduction.definition: 滑动窗口维护一个连续区间，边界前移时增删少量信息，避免重复扫描。
introduction.example: 正数数组[1,2,3,1]，求和至少5的最短连续区间。

exercise.question: 满足条件后为什么还要移动左边界？
exercise.answer: 为了缩短区间，直到再缩就不满足。

derivation: 正数保证右扩时和不减、左缩时和不增，所以每个边界只需向前。
每项最多加入和移除一次，总时间O(n)。

calculation.scenario: 正数数组[1,2,3,1]，求和至少5的最短连续区间。
steps: 读到3时和为6、长度3；去掉左侧1后和5、长度2。
再去掉2只剩3不满足，最后答案长度2，对应[2,3]。
calculation.result: 再去掉2只剩3不满足，最后答案长度2，对应[2,3]。

application.scenario: 统计最近5分钟事件数。
steps: 按时间入队，删除早于当前时间减5分钟的记录。
维护计数并明确时间边界是否包含，避免窗口端点重复。
application.result: 维护计数并明确时间边界是否包含，避免窗口端点重复。

transfer.question: 含负数后还能直接用上述最短和窗口吗？
steps: 负数会让右扩降低和、左缩增加和，原单调性失效。
如[1,−1,5]，需采用前缀和配单调队列等适合负数的算法。

blocks.text: The sliding window maintains a contiguous interval, allowing the right end to incorporate new elements, the left end to remove old elements, and incrementally update status such as frequency. First define when the current range is legal, and then decide when to shrink. In the longest substring without repeated characters, once a new character causes repetition, the window will continue to be narrowed until there are no more repetitions, and then the maximum length will be updated.

For example, on the second b in abba, move left past both the leading a and the first b; removing just one character is insufficient. If using last-seen indices, set left to the maximum of its current value and the repeated character’s previous index plus one. This prevents left from moving backward at the final a.

worked.title: Sliding Window: Shrink Until a Duplicate Is Removed
worked.scenario: For the string abcaad, find the longest contiguous substring with no repeated character. Maintain a character set for [left,right].
steps: Read a, b and c to form abc of length 3. Before adding the next a, detect the duplicate, remove the leftmost a and advance left to 1.
The window becomes bca. The next a is another duplicate. Remove b, c and then a until the old a is gone, then insert the new a.
Finally read d. The current window ad has length 2; the best length remains 3. Each character is inserted and removed at most once.
worked.result: The answer is 3, achieved by abc or bca. Time O(n); set space O(min(n, alphabet size)).
worked.pitfall: Advancing left only once may leave an invalid window. A substring must be contiguous; it cannot skip characters in the middle.
worked.question: What is the answer for aaaa?
worked.answer: 1. Each new a requires removing the old a from the window.

depth.boundary: With negative values, interval sums are not monotonic under expansion; positive-array window rules do not apply unchanged.

introduction.definition: Softmax把一组分数变成和为1的概率，常用于互斥类别。
introduction.example: 分数[0,ln3]。

exercise.question: 给所有分数加同一个数会改变概率吗？
exercise.answer: 不会，分子分母同乘一个指数因子而抵消。

derivation: pᵢ=exp(zᵢ)/Σexp(zⱼ)，所有输出为正且和为1。
先减最大分数不改变结果，并避免对巨大正数取指数。

calculation.scenario: 分数[0,ln3]。

application.scenario: 给3类图像模型输出概率。
steps: 沿类别轴softmax，核对每个样本概率和约为1。
训练交叉熵通常直接接分数，展示或推理时再转换。
application.result: 训练交叉熵通常直接接分数，展示或推理时再转换。

transfer.question: 分数改为[1000,1000+ln3]如何稳定计算？

blocks.text: Softmax converts a vector of real class scores into nonnegative values summing to one. It is commonly used for a choice among mutually exclusive classes.
For K scores z_j, p_i=exp(z_i)/Σ_j exp(z_j). Subtracting the same constant from every score leaves the result unchanged; subtracting the maximum before exponentiation improves numerical stability.
Scores [0,log(2)] produce probabilities [1/3,2/3]. Adding 100 to both scores gives the same probabilities. Increasing one class score changes the other probabilities through the shared denominator.

depth.boundary: Independent multilabel outputs do not require mutually exclusive softmax merely because many labels exist.

introduction.definition: 张量形状说明每个维度多大，轴说明操作沿哪一维进行。

exercise.question: 沿轴0求和会得到两个数吗？

blocks.text: For now, think of a tensor as a multidimensional array. Its shape gives its size along each direction; an axis identifies a direction of organization or computation. A color-image batch can have sample, channel, height, and width axes. “Dimension” may mean the number of axes or the size of one axis, so context matters. Embedding dimension usually means components per vector, not dataset sample count. Shape mismatches concern data alignment, not necessarily a flaw in the algorithm's principle.

worked.title: Tensor Broadcasting: A Column and a Row Form a Matrix
worked.scenario: Predictions have shape [3,1] and labels have shape [3]. Use ordinary elementwise subtraction to calculate errors.
steps: Broadcasting aligns trailing axes: [3,1] and [1,3] broadcast to [3,3]. This no longer pairs three samples one to one.
Explicitly reshaping labels to [3,1] gives three zero rows, matching the intended sample pairing.
worked.result: Wrong shapes can yield a valid computation with incorrect meaning. Check shapes, axis meanings and the expected output shape.
worked.pitfall: Do not infer that every loss interface broadcasts automatically. BCEWithLogitsLoss requires identical input and target shapes.
worked.question: Why is this harder to detect at batch=1?
worked.answer: Broadcasting [1,1] with [1] still produces one number, so small tests can hide the axis error.

depth.boundary: “Dimension” may mean the number of axes or the size of one axis; check context.

introduction.definition: 阈值把连续分数转成决策，阈值越低通常越容易报正。

exercise.answer: 不一定，取决于校准、类别比例和误判成本。

derivation: 决策规则p≥t为正，改变t会同时改变TP、FP、FN。
阈值应在验证集按目标约束选择，再锁定用于测试。

transfer.question: 同一例把t降至0.2会怎样？

召回1、查准率1/3；降低阈值并不保证整体更好。

blocks.text: A classification threshold must still be chosen after predicting probabilities. Raising it usually produces fewer positive predictions but may miss more actual positives. The confusion matrix distinguishes true positives, false positives, true negatives and false negatives. Sensitivity usually means recall, or the true positive rate. Specificity measures the proportion of actual negatives correctly excluded. These measure different aspects of performance and should be discussed in terms of missed detections and false alarms.

worked.title: Thresholds: Recalculate the Confusion Matrix
worked.scenario: Scores [.95,.8,.7,.6,.4,.3,.2,.05] have true labels [1,0,1,0,1,0,0,0]. Predict positive when the score is at least the threshold.
steps: At threshold 0.5, the first four predictions are positive: two true positives and two false positives. The remainder contains one false negative and three true negatives.
Lowering the threshold to 0.4 finds the third actual positive: TP=3, FP=2, FN=0, TN=3.
worked.result: Lowering the threshold expands the predicted-positive set. Recall cannot decrease, but precision need not be monotonic. The demo’s scores themselves do not change.
worked.pitfall: With no predicted positives, the precision denominator is 0. The demo displays “undefined” rather than treating this as 100%. Applications must define their convention.
worked.question: At threshold 1, what are the accuracy and recall?
worked.answer: Every prediction is negative: accuracy is 5/8, recall is 0, and precision is undefined.

depth.boundary: Choose thresholds on validation data according to false-positive and false-negative costs.

blocks.text: 词元（token）是分词器处理文本的离散单位，可以是一段字节、字符或子词。嵌入（embedding）把离散词元编号映射为可学习向量；编号本身的大小不代表语义距离。
词表大小为 V、向量维度为 d 时，嵌入矩阵 $E\in\mathbb R^{V\times d}$；编号 i 的向量为第 i 行 Eᵢ。长度 L 的序列查表后形状为 L×d。分词器版本决定文本怎样转成编号，后续注意力处理上下文，这两步不能混成一个定义。
玩具词表中编号 7 的向量为 (0.2,−0.4)，编号 9 为 (0.1,0.6)，序列 [7,9,7] 得到三行二维向量。相同编号查到相同初始向量，但经上下文网络后，两个位置的表示可以不同。金融文本还需检查文本实际到达时间。

depth.boundary: A token need not correspond to one character or one word.

blocks.text: For Course Schedule, encode prerequisites as directed edges. Enqueue every zero-in-degree vertex, process it, and decrement its successors’ in-degrees. Enqueue a successor when its in-degree reaches zero. All courses are feasible exactly when all vertices are processed; otherwise the remaining graph contains a directed cycle. Include isolated courses in the total.

A DFS alternative uses visitation colors. Encountering a vertex that is still on the active recursion path reveals a directed cycle; encountering a fully processed vertex does not. A topological order exists only for a DAG. Ordinary BFS without dependency bookkeeping does not provide this test.

worked.title: Topological Sorting: An Empty Queue Can Reveal a Cycle
worked.scenario: Dependencies are A→C, B→C, C→D and D→E; F has none. An edge means its source must finish before its destination.
steps: Compute indegrees. A, B and F have indegree 0 and enter the queue. Removing A and B decreases C’s indegree; enqueue C only when it reaches 0.
C then releases D, and D releases E. F must also appear in the output despite being isolated.
Adding E→C leaves the queue empty after processing A, B and F, while C, D and E remain unprocessed in a directed cycle.
worked.result: Without the cycle, one topological order contains all 6 nodes. With it, only 3 nodes are processed, proving no topological order covers the whole graph. Time O(V+E).
worked.pitfall: Topological orders are usually not unique. Processing some nodes does not establish that the entire dependency graph is executable.
worked.question: Is checking only the subgraph reachable from one starting node enough?
worked.answer: No. Another component may contain a cycle. Count processed nodes across all V nodes.

depth.boundary: If the in-degree algorithm cannot process every vertex, a directed cycle exists. Encountering a previously visited vertex alone is insufficient evidence.

introduction.definition: train/eval改变Dropout与BatchNorm等层的行为；no_grad关闭梯度记录，二者用途不同。
introduction.example: Dropout输入2，丢弃率0.5，随后做模型验证。

no_grad只影响计算图记录，不改变模块训练标志。

steps: train加no_grad仍以各0.5概率输出0、4。
eval加no_grad输出2且不记录梯度，是常规验证组合。

application.scenario: 评估分类器验证准确率。
steps: 保存当前模式，切换eval并在no_grad环境遍历验证集。
统计指标后恢复train，防止后续训练继续使用冻结的归一化统计。
