applications.reason: 从循环网络扩展到门控记忆的金融输入契约，处理时间窗口、资产边界与状态恢复。

introduction.definition: MLOps把数据、训练、验证、部署和监控连成可追踪流程，让模型服务可复现、回滚与维护。
introduction.example: 交付蛋糕不只交配方，还需原料批次、烤箱条件和质量记录。

exercise.question: 只交模型权重为什么无法保证复现蛋糕配方？
exercise.answer: 数据版本、预处理、代码与运行环境也决定行为，必须共同追踪。

derivation: 模型行为由数据版本、代码、配置、环境和权重共同决定。
将这些绑定到不可变运行记录，发布引用明确版本，监控线上输入与输出。

calculation.scenario: 1000个请求，新模型分到10%流量，出现8次错误，旧模型900次有9次。
steps: 新模型错误率8/100=8%。
旧模型错误率9/900=1%。
calculation.result: 差7个百分点，触发预设门槛时应暂停或回滚并排查。

application.scenario: 发布需求预测服务。
steps: 先离线验证，再小流量发布，保存旧版本与回滚入口。
持续监控延迟、错误、数据漂移及延迟到达的真实标签。
application.result: 运行健康与预测质量是两类指标。

transfer.question: 若新模型无服务错误但误差翻倍呢？
steps: HTTP成功不代表预测正确。
需按真实标签计算业务误差并按质量门槛处理。
transfer.answer: MLOps不能只监控接口在线。

blocks.text: MLOps 把数据、训练、验证、模型发布和运行监控组织成可追踪的工程流程。交付物是一套能够复现和维护的预测服务，而不只是一个模型权重文件。
一次预测应能追溯到数据版本、特征契约、预处理参数、模型版本和配置。发布前有独立评价与回滚规则，发布后分别监控数据质量、服务表现和标签到齐后的预测质量；没有通用公式替代这些状态与责任边界。
模型 v2 出现异常时，日志能把预测关联到输入快照 D17、缩放参数 S4 与权重 M2；回退到 v1 要同时恢复兼容的 S3 和特征契约。只替换权重而保留不兼容预处理，不能复现旧行为。

depth.boundary: Better offline metrics do not guarantee favorable production distributions or business outcomes.

introduction.definition: 多模态表示把图片、文字、声音等不同形式的信息编码为可比较或可联合处理的向量。
introduction.example: 图片里的猫与文字“猫”形式不同，但模型可学到它们应靠近。

exercise.question: 猫图片与文字“猫”形式不同，如何比较？
exercise.answer: 分别编码到已对齐向量空间，再用余弦等分数比较，不直接比较原始像素和字符。

derivation: 图像编码器g和文本编码器h分别输出向量，并通常归一化。
用配对样本提高相似度、非配对样本降低相似度；学到的接近不等于完整语义等价。

steps: 点积即余弦：猫0.8、狗0。
按最高相似度选猫。
calculation.result: 0.8是相似分数，不自动等于80%正确概率。

application.scenario: 实现文字搜图片。
steps: 预先编码图片并建向量索引，查询文字经文本编码器。
返回近邻并用真实检索任务评估召回及偏差。
application.result: 跨模态对齐质量决定检索效果。

transfer.question: 若图片向量变成(0,1)，结果怎样？
steps: 与猫相似0.6，与狗相似1。
最高分变为狗。
transfer.answer: 表征或输入变化可改变检索排序，需防止域外过度解释。

blocks.text: Word2Vec learns vectors from word–context co-occurrence. GloVe uses global co-occurrence statistics, while FastText adds subword information to handle word forms and unseen words. Their typical word representations are context independent. Contextual embeddings instead give a word different vectors in different sentences, such as apple as a fruit versus Apple as a company. Nearby vectors reflect a learned relationship, not necessarily exact synonymy.

SimCLR treats different augmented views of the same image as positive pairs and learns a stable visual representation. CLIP brings the matched image and text closer and distinguishes them from other pairs to obtain a cross-modal space. It can use text category descriptions for zero-shot classification or image and text retrieval, but it is not a chat model that is inherently capable of generating long answers. The quality of the training image-text pairs, negative samples, and augmentation design all affect the learned associations.

BYOL, DINO and related self-distillation approaches train one branch to match a teacher branch’s representation, with teacher updates and mechanisms to prevent collapse. They do not always require explicit negative examples. Masked autoencoders hide much of an input and learn to reconstruct it, emphasizing structural completion. Learning useful representations does not by itself produce an instruction-following agent; downstream interfaces still need training.

Vision–language models connect a visual encoder to language capabilities. A projector maps visual features into representations accepted by a language model; cross-attention offers another interaction mechanism. Image resolution, visual-token count and cropping affect recognition of small text and fine details. OCR recognizes text; broader visual understanding also includes positions, relationships and scenes. They are not interchangeable.

ASR converts speech to text using approaches such as CTC, encoder–decoder models or transducers. Transducers commonly support streaming recognition with different input and output lengths. TTS converts text to speech; a vocoder converts acoustic representations to waveforms. A mel spectrogram is a common time–frequency representation; codec tokens encode audio as discrete units. Word error rate, or WER, measures transcription errors, not tone, timbre or speech naturalness.

sections.title: Video Token, Temporal Consistency, Optical Flow [Overview]

blocks.text: Video requires modeling change over time, not merely processing more images. Temporal consistency concerns whether objects maintain their identity, appearance and plausible motion. Optical flow estimates local visual motion and supports tracking and video analysis, though camera movement and occlusion complicate interpretation. Coherent-looking generated video can still violate contact mechanics, gravity or action–outcome relationships. Distinguish visual quality from physical prediction.

Point clouds represent scenes with 3D points and additional attributes. NeRF learns a spatially and view-dependent radiance field to render novel views. 3D Gaussian splatting represents and renders scenes efficiently with optimizable spatial Gaussian primitives. These solve 3D representation and view synthesis, rather than necessarily learning how forces move objects. Static reconstruction, interactive world modeling and robot control are distinct levels.

worked.title: Cross-Modal Representation: Cosine Similarity Is Not Fact-Checking
worked.scenario: Use image vector [1,0] and text vectors [2,0] and [1,1] to illustrate vector comparison only.
steps: The image’s cosine similarity with the first text is 2/(1×2)=1; with the second it is 1/√2≈0.707.
After normalization, the first text vector is [1,0] and the second is approximately [.707,.707]. Their dot products with the image vector equal cosine similarities.
Scaling the first text vector to [20,0] still gives cosine 1, showing invariance to positive rescaling of vector magnitude.
worked.result: Shared representations turn cross-modal retrieval into a nearest-vector problem. These artificial vectors neither train nor validate a real image–text model.
worked.pitfall: Similarity is not correctness or probability. Cosine for a zero vector is undefined. Models can still misread negation, quantities and detailed spatial relationships.
worked.question: What is the cosine for text vector [-1,0]?
worked.answer: -1, indicating opposite direction. Semantic interpretation still depends on the learned space.

depth.boundary: Embedding similarity, cross-modal understanding, and reliable action are distinct evaluation goals.

introduction.definition: Bellman关系把长期价值拆成当前奖励与下一状态的折现价值，像把长账单分成本次与余下部分。
introduction.example: 走一步拿2分，后面预计还能得10分但按九折计，当前价值是11。

exercise.question: 即时2分、后续10分折九折，价值为何11？

derivation: 固定策略下V(s)=Σaπ(a给定s)Σs′P(s′给定s,a)[r+γV(s′)]。
最优价值把对行动的策略平均改为max；0≤γ<1的有限状态折扣模型有收缩性质。

calculation.scenario: 状态A可选行动：左奖励2、到价值10；右奖励4、到价值6，γ=0.9。
calculation.result: 贪心选择左，当前奖励较小但长期价值较高。

application.scenario: 为仓库机器人规划奖励。
steps: 定义位置、行动、碰撞惩罚与到达奖励。
按状态反复Bellman更新直至误差门槛，再提取策略。
application.result: 模型转移错误会使计算出的策略失效。

transfer.question: 若γ降为0.2呢？
steps: 最优改选右。
transfer.answer: 重视短期的折扣会改变行动选择。

blocks.text: Bellman 关系把长期价值分解为当前奖励与后续状态的折现价值。固定策略的价值评估与在可选行动中寻找最优策略，是两个不同问题。
固定策略 π 下，$V^\pi(s)=E_\pi[r_{t+1}+\gamma V^\pi(s_{t+1})\mid s_t=s]$。最优动作价值为 $Q^*(s,a)=E[r_{t+1}+\gamma\max_{a'}Q^*(s_{t+1},a')\mid s_t=s,a_t=a]$。γ 为折扣，s、a 为状态和行动；真正终止后未来价值为零，时间截断不必等于终止。
一个行动立即得到奖励 2，随后确定进入价值 5 的非终止状态，γ=0.9，则该次 Bellman 目标为 2+0.9×5=6.5。若这一步已经真正终止，目标只有 2。交易奖励如何纳入费用和库存风险，见金融应用。

worked.title: Q-Learning: No Bootstrapping at True Termination
worked.scenario: Current Q(s,a)=2, reward r=1, maximum next-state Q=4, discount γ=0.9 and learning rate α=0.5.
steps: For a nonterminal transition, the target is r+γ max Q=1+0.9×4=4.6.
The TD error is 4.6-2=2.6. Update Q=2+0.5×2.6=3.3.
At a true terminal state, the target is only r=1, giving 2+0.5×(1-2)=1.5.
worked.result: The same observed reward produces different learning targets depending on termination. One tabular Q-learning update does not establish a fully learned policy.
worked.pitfall: Distinguish true termination from time-limit truncation. Bootstrapping depends on the task and interface semantics. Q-learning uses the maximum next-state value; SARSA uses the actual next action’s value.
worked.question: With α=1, what is the updated value for the nonterminal transition?
worked.answer: It becomes the current target, 4.6. This does not mean the target estimate is noise-free.

depth.boundary: Value depends on the policy, discount, and task; single-step rewards alone are insufficient for comparison.

applications.title: Reinforcement Learning for Trading · 强化学习的交易应用
applications.reason: 先掌握状态、行动、奖励与 Bellman 关系，再定义交易环境的成交、成本和风险边界。

introduction.definition: 策略梯度直接调整行动概率的参数，以提高期望回报，不要求先对每个行动求最优值。
introduction.example: 成功的尝试使类似行动更可能，但不能忽略失败样本和探索。

exercise.question: 一次成功就把该行动概率改100%合理吗？
exercise.answer: 不合理；回报有噪声，需批量估计梯度并保留探索，单次样本不证明最优。

derivation: 对随机策略，梯度可写E[∇logπθ(a给定s)G]。
减去不依赖当前行动的基线b不改变期望梯度，可降低方差。

calculation.scenario: 单状态选A概率p=sigmoid(θ)=0.5，选到A，回报3、基线1、学习率0.1。
steps: 梯度样本1，θ从0升至0.1，p约0.525。
calculation.result: 这是一次带噪更新，不证明整体最优。

application.scenario: 训练仿真控制策略。
steps: 收集按当前策略生成的轨迹和折扣回报。
估计优势、批量更新，并监控回报方差与安全约束。
application.result: 样本量与分布变化影响训练稳定性。

transfer.question: 若同次回报0、基线1呢？
transfer.answer: 低于基线的行动概率下降。

blocks.text: A policy-gradient method adjusts parameters of an action policy to improve expected return. A stochastic policy π_θ(a|s) gives the probability of taking action a in state s.

A score-function gradient has the form E[∇_θ log π_θ(a|s) A(s,a)], under the sampling and return convention of the algorithm. A is an advantage estimate comparing the action with a baseline; an inaccurate estimate can increase variance or bias.

If an action has higher estimated advantage than the baseline, a small ascent update tends to increase its sampled log probability. One fortunate reward is not enough to identify a reliable advantage; exploration and estimation affect the update.

depth.boundary: Constraints in a policy objective differ from gradient clipping.

introduction.definition: 模仿学习从专家示范学习行动规则；行为克隆把观测映射到示范行动，但执行时会遇到自己造成的新状态。
introduction.example: 跟着教练录像学开车，偏离车道后可能看到录像里没有的景象。

exercise.question: 录像里会开车，为什么偏离车道后会失误？
exercise.answer: 它进入专家示范未覆盖的状态，小错误改变未来输入分布。

derivation: 行为克隆最小化示范状态上的行动损失。
小错误改变后续状态分布，误差可累积；交互式收集纠正示范能覆盖新状态。

calculation.scenario: 10个示范，模型预测对8个、错2个。
steps: 示范分类准确率8/10=80%。
若简化假设每步独立正确率0.8，5步全对概率0.8^5=32.768%。
calculation.result: 现实错误相关，该乘法只是说明长程成功不等于单步准确率。

application.scenario: 训练仓储机械臂模仿抓取。
steps: 先在示范数据训练，再在安全仿真中运行。
记录偏离状态并请专家给纠正行动，加入数据后重训。
application.result: 部署评价应看完整任务成功和失败状态覆盖。

transfer.question: 若新增纠正数据使单步率到95%，5步简化成功率呢？
transfer.answer: 需要检验闭环轨迹，而不只离线准确率。

blocks.text: Imitation learning trains a policy using expert demonstrations. Behavior cloning is its supervised form: predict the demonstrated action from the recorded observation. Other imitation methods can query an expert or match broader behavior.

For demonstrations (s_i,a_i), behavior cloning minimizes an action loss Σ_i L(π_θ(s_i),a_i). The dataset covers expert-visited states, which may differ from states reached after the learner makes mistakes; this is distribution shift.

A driving policy trained only on centered-lane images may drift slightly at deployment and encounter images absent from training. Collecting expert corrections on learner-visited states targets this coverage gap; simply lowering training loss on the original images may not.

depth.boundary: Behavior cloning may fit demonstrations without keeping its own rollout states within the demonstration distribution.

concepts.title: Motion Planning · 图搜索在机器人路径中的应用

introduction.definition: 运动规划寻找从起点到目标的无碰撞运动路径；构型表示位置或关节角，真实可执行还受动力学限制。
introduction.example: 搬沙发过门，不能只看沙发中心能否通过，还要看整体姿态与大小。

exercise.question: 沙发中心能穿门是否足够？
exercise.answer: 不够；整个形状与姿态都须无碰撞，真实执行还受速度和加速度限制。

derivation: 把机器人几何体与障碍结合，得到不可进入的构型区域。
采样或离散合法构型为节点，局部无碰撞运动为边，再搜索路径并检查执行约束。

calculation.scenario: 平面点机器人从(0,0)到(2,0)，障碍阻断直线，经(1,1)绕行。
steps: 两段长各√2。
calculation.result: 前提是两段全程无碰撞，而非仅三个节点安全。

application.scenario: 机械臂避障。
steps: 在关节角空间采样并做整条连边碰撞检测。
路径平滑后重新检测，再按速度/加速度限制做时间参数化。
application.result: 几何路径可行不等于可任意速度执行。

transfer.question: 机器人半径从0变0.5，原路径一定可用吗？
steps: 把障碍按半径0.5膨胀后再检查中心路径。
若最小间距仅0.3，原路径会碰撞。
transfer.answer: 机器人尺寸改变会改变自由构型空间。

blocks.text: 运动规划是在机器人构型空间中寻找从起点到目标的无碰撞路径。构型可以是一组关节角；离散化后，可把可行构型作为节点、允许的局部运动作为边，再使用图搜索。图上有路径并不自动代表真实机器人能按任意速度执行。
设构型为 q，路径为 q(s)，s∈[0,1]，要求路径位于无碰撞集合。离散路径成本可写 \(C=\sum_{(u,v)\in\text{path}}c(u,v)\)。只有声明边权非负等适用条件后，才能选择相应最短路算法。路径加上时间参数后，还需检查速度、加速度与执行器限制。
机械臂的起止关节角都安全，中间直线插值仍可能扫过桌边。规划器可以经一个绕行构型连接起终点，但要检查整条边上的碰撞，而不只是节点。之后再给路径分配执行时间；这一步与预测模型、实时反馈控制有不同职责。

depth.boundary: Geometric paths, dynamic constraints, state estimation, and feedback control address different parts of robot motion.

introduction.definition: 并查集维护互不相交的集合，支持查询代表和合并；适合连通性，不直接维护完整路径。
introduction.example: 朋友圈合并后，判断两人是否属于同一个大群，不必列出所有好友链。

exercise.question: 同朋友圈必须知道两人间具体好友链吗？
exercise.answer: 不必；代表相同即可判断同集合，但无法由此恢复完整路径。

derivation: 每个元素指向父节点，根代表集合。
按大小合并避免高树，路径压缩把查询路径指向根，摊还复杂度接近常数。

calculation.scenario: 4个元素初始独立，执行union(0,1)、union(2,3)、union(1,2)。
steps: 最后find(0)=find(3)，连通分量大小4。
calculation.result: 根编号可能依实现变化，不应当永久业务ID。

application.scenario: 检查无向图加边是否成环。
steps: 加边(u,v)前查是否同根。
若同根，新边形成环；否则合并。
application.result: 可用于Kruskal选不成环的边。

transfer.question: 需要删除一条好友边，并查集能直接拆群吗？
steps: 父树不保留原图全部边结构。
删除连接关系无法仅从根信息恢复分裂结果。
transfer.answer: 需离线回滚或更强动态连通结构。

blocks.text: Disjoint-set union (DSU) maintains disjoint sets. find returns a set representative, and union merges two sets. Two nodes are connected exactly when their representatives match. Representatives may change after unions, so do not treat a root’s label as a permanent application ID.

Ordinary disjoint-set union is good at online queries that only add connections, and cannot directly reverse a union to process arbitrary deletions. Offline dynamic connectivity, rollback structures, etc. require additional design; when rolling back, it is usually avoided to directly use path compression that is difficult to recover.

worked.title: Union-Find: Repeated Connections Do Not Reduce Set Count
worked.scenario: Six nodes 0…5 receive undirected connections (0,1), (2,3), (1,2), (0,3), (4,5), in that order.
steps: Start with 6 sets. The first two connections each merge a pair, leaving 4 sets.
After merging (1,2), nodes 0,1,2,3 share one set. The count becomes 3.
For (0,3), both roots already match, so no merge occurs. Finally (4,5) reduces the count to 2.
worked.result: The final partition is {0,1,2,3} and {4,5}. Representatives depend on the union strategy, but membership does not.
worked.pitfall: Do not subtract one for every edge. Repeated edges or edges closing a cycle may cause no new union.
worked.question: Remove (1,2) but still add (0,3). How many final sets remain?
worked.answer: Still 2. Connection (0,3) merges the previously separate {0,1} and {2,3}.

depth.boundary: Ordinary DSU mainly handles added connections. Path compression changes tree shape without changing set membership.

introduction.definition: 0–1 BFS在边权只有0和1时，用双端队列求单源最短路，让免费边优先处理。
introduction.example: 走普通路花1，传送门花0，不能按边数少就认定费用低。

exercise.question: 两条免费边为何能胜过一条收费边？
exercise.answer: 最短路最小化权重和而非边数，0+0<1。

derivation: 成功松弛0边，把目标放队首；1边放队尾。
队列按当前距离相邻层组织，使较小距离优先；复杂度O(V+E)。

calculation.scenario: 边s→a权1、s→b权0、b→a权0。
steps: 处理s后dist(a)=1、dist(b)=0，队列[b,a]。
先处理b，将a改为0并放队首。
calculation.result: a的最短费用0，虽需两条边。

application.scenario: 网格中最少修改方向。
steps: 沿格子原箭头移动设0，改方向设1。
在网格节点运行0–1 BFS，目标距离就是修改次数。
application.result: 状态和边权必须准确反映一次修改的成本。

transfer.question: 若加一条权重2的边还能照搬吗？
steps: 队首/队尾只区分0与1，距离层不再由该规则保证。
需改用Dijkstra或合适的整数桶。
transfer.answer: 0–1约束是正确性的条件。

blocks.text: 0–1 BFS finds shortest paths when every edge weight is either zero or one. It uses a deque to process zero-cost relaxations before cost-one relaxations.

When improving dist[v] through an edge from u, push v to the front for weight 0 and to the back for weight 1. With a proper adjacency-list implementation, complexity is O(V+E). Other weights require a different algorithm or transformation.
If A→B costs 1, A→C costs 0 and C→B costs 0, the shortest distance to B is 0 through C. Plain unweighted BFS would prefer the one-edge path, while the deque respects actual zero-one cost.

depth.boundary: Relax whenever distance improves; first enqueueing does not make a distance final.

introduction.definition: Bellman–Ford反复松弛所有边，允许负权；还能发现从起点可达的负环。
introduction.example: 优惠路段可让某条边费用为负，但绕一圈不断返现会使最低费用无下界。

exercise.question: 绕一圈总费−1为什么不能给有限最低价？
exercise.answer: 可反复绕环，每次再减1，使可达相关终点的费用无下界。

derivation: 初始化源距离0、其他无穷，每轮用d[v]=min(d[v],d[u]+w)。
无负环时最短简单路至多V−1条边；第V轮仍可改进说明存在可达负环。

steps: 直接到b成本5。
经a为4−2=2，松弛将b改成2。
calculation.result: 最终dist(a)=4、dist(b)=2。

application.scenario: 检测兑换图负环。
steps: 把汇率r映射为−ln(r)，考虑方向和费用。
负环意味着模型内循环乘积大于1，再核对报价可成交性。
application.result: 静态图信号不保证真实同时套利。

transfer.question: 加入b→a=1会怎样？
steps: 该环从s可达，可反复降低a、b距离。
transfer.answer: 两点没有有限最短路，需报告负环影响。

blocks.text: Bellman–Ford computes single-source shortest-path distances with possibly negative edge weights and can detect a reachable negative cycle. A reachable negative cycle can make some minimum path costs unbounded below.

Relax an edge u→v of weight w using dist[v]=min(dist[v],dist[u]+w). After at most V-1 full passes, shortest simple paths are covered. An additional reachable improvement signals a reachable negative cycle. The usual complexity is O(VE).
For A→B cost 4, A→C cost 5 and B→C cost -2, the best cost to C is 2 via B. Negative weights invalidate Dijkstra’s usual nonnegative-weight assumption, but are allowed by Bellman–Ford.

depth.boundary: A negative cycle unreachable from the source does not invalidate all that source’s results.

introduction.definition: 树状数组把前缀和拆成由最低二进制位决定的区间块，使单点增量和前缀查询都很快。
introduction.example: 账本把每天收入汇成不同长度的小账块，查总额只拼几个块。

exercise.question: 前6项为何可拼长度2和4两块？
exercise.answer: lowbit(6)=2，先取[5,6]，减到4再取[1,4]，两段不重叠且覆盖前缀。

derivation: 一基下tree[i]存[i−lowbit(i)+1,i]的和，lowbit(i)=i&−i。
查询反复减lowbit，更新反复加lowbit，均O(log n)。

calculation.result: 只读两个区间块。

application.scenario: 动态统计排名前缀次数。
steps: 把值离散化为有序索引，每出现一次在该索引加1。
查询前缀得到不大于某值的数量，区间用两前缀相减。
application.result: 离散化要保留顺序而非原数值间距。

transfer.question: 第3项增加2后，prefix(6)多少？
steps: 更新tree[3]、tree[4]，索引8越界停止。
tree[6]仍11、tree[4]变12。
transfer.answer: 前缀和23，不能直接把赋值当增量。

blocks.text: In a one-based Fenwick tree, tree[i] stores the sum of an interval of length lowbit(i). In the appropriate integer representation, lowbit(i)=i & (-i) extracts the least significant set bit.

worked.title: Fenwick Trees: Queries and Updates Move Differently
worked.scenario: Use the one-based array a=[2,1,3,4,2]. The tree stores interval sums, initially tree[1…5]=[2,3,3,10,2].
steps: For the first 5 elements, read tree[5]=2, subtract lowbit(5)=1 to reach index 4, then read tree[4]=10. The total is 12.
Add 2 at position 3: tree[3] changes from 3 to 5, then tree[4] from 10 to 12. The next index 8 exceeds n, so stop.
The new total is 14. The sum over positions 2…4 is prefix(4)-prefix(1)=12-2=10.
worked.result: A Fenwick update touches only binary interval blocks containing the position. Each query or update path takes at most O(log n) steps.
worked.pitfall: Index 0 is unsuitable as a starting point for this one-based update interface because lowbit(0)=0.
worked.question: If the increment at position 3 were -2 instead, what would the sum of the first five elements be?
worked.answer: 10: original total 12 minus 2. The structure supports negative increments too.

depth.boundary: The one-based update interface excludes index 0; obtain range sums by subtracting prefixes.

introduction.definition: 线段树把数组递归分段，每个节点保存可结合的摘要，支持区间查询和更新。
introduction.example: 像分层账本，先按半本合计，再用少量整段合计回答任意区间。

exercise.question: 分层账本为何不必每次重扫整段？
exercise.answer: 预存完整子段摘要，查询只合并覆盖目标的少量节点。

derivation: 父摘要由左右子摘要合并，合并需满足结合律并有空段单位元。
单点修改只重算一条祖先链，区间查询分解为O(log n)个覆盖节点。

calculation.result: 区间端点约定决定是否包含第4项。

application.scenario: 维护区间最小值。
steps: 叶子存数值，父节点取min，空段单位元设正无穷。
修改某值后沿父链重算，查询不必扫描全部元素。
application.result: 同一结构可换摘要，但合并规则须合法。

transfer.question: 要把区间平均数直接相加作为摘要可行吗？
steps: 左右长度不同会导致错误权重。
改存(sum,count)，合并分别相加，最后sum/count。
transfer.answer: 摘要必须保留正确合并所需的信息。

blocks.text: The segment tree recursively splits the interval in half, with the parent node holding a mergeable summary of both sides, such as sum, min, max, or count. The query interval is divided into a small number of completely covered nodes, and then the answers are merged; point modification only recalculates a path from the root to the leaf.

worked.title: Segment Trees: Range Maxima Cannot Be Subtracted
worked.scenario: For [2,1,3,4,2,6], query the maximum in the zero-based half-open interval [1,5).
steps: The selected values are [1,3,4,2], with maximum 4. Index 5 containing 6 is excluded.
Decompose the range into segment-tree nodes and merge their summaries with max. Negative infinity can serve as the merge identity.
Changing index 2 from 3 to 9 updates only the relevant leaf and ancestors. Querying [1,5) now returns 9.
worked.result: The query determines what each node stores. Sums, maxima and more complex summaries have different merge rules.
worked.pitfall: prefixMax(5)-prefixMax(1) does not give the range maximum. Define the result for an empty interval explicitly.
worked.question: If every value is negative, is 0 a valid initial merge value?
worked.answer: No. It may exceed every real value. Use a suitable identity or handle empty results explicitly.

depth.boundary: Lazy-tag composition order and summary updates must match the operation.

introduction.definition: 差分数组记录相邻值的变化量，把整段加法变成两个端点调整，最后前缀累加还原。
introduction.example: 把开水龙头记为流量+3、关掉记为−3，中间不用每秒重复记录。

exercise.question: 关水龙头的负变化应该记在哪？
exercise.answer: 闭区间最后位置仍需保留流量，因此在r+1减回，防止后续继续累积。

derivation: 闭区间[l,r]加x时d[l]+=x、d[r+1]−=x，预留尾哨兵。

calculation.scenario: 四项初始全0，对[1,2]加3。
calculation.result: 每次更新O(1)，最终还原O(n)。

application.scenario: 批量统计区间预约占用。
steps: 每份预约起点加人数、结束后一位减人数。
处理全部预约后扫描前缀，得到每时段人数及峰值。
application.result: 适合离线批量更新，频繁在线查询需其他结构。

transfer.question: 再给[0,3]加2，结果是什么？
transfer.answer: 末尾r+1哨兵防止越界和错误延长更新。

blocks.text: A difference array may use zero-based or one-based indices, but reserve the position after the right endpoint. To add x over a closed range [l,r], add x to d[l] and subtract x from d[r+1]. Prefix accumulation then reconstructs the updated array.
Step 1: Allocate a length-6 difference array. The first update adds 2 to d[1] and subtracts 2 from d[4].

worked.title: Difference Arrays: Undo the Increment After the Range
worked.scenario: Start with a zero-based, length-5 array of zeros. Add 2 to inclusive [1,3], then add -1 to [2,4], reconstructing the array afterward.
steps: Allocate a length-6 difference array. The first update adds 2 to d[1] and subtracts 2 from d[4].
The second subtracts 1 from d[2] and adds 1 to d[5]. Position d[5] is a sentinel canceling the update after the array ends.
Prefix-sum the first five differences to obtain values 0,2,1,1,-1 at positions 0…4.
worked.result: The final array is [0,2,1,1,-1]. Each range update changes two endpoints; final reconstruction takes O(n).
worked.pitfall: For an inclusive range, cancel at r+1 rather than r. Allocate the sentinel but do not return it as a sixth array value.
worked.question: For a half-open range [l,r), where is the cancellation?
worked.answer: At d[r], because r is already outside the updated range.

depth.boundary: Basic difference arrays suit offline reconstruction; online queries usually require another structure.

introduction.definition: KMP用模式自身的前后缀关系，在失配时保留仍可能匹配的部分，避免文本指针反复退回。
introduction.example: 拼积木时尾部恰好像下一轮开头，可以接着拼而非全部拆掉。

exercise.question: 尾部像新开头时为什么不必全重来？
exercise.answer: 该尾部已经验证等于模式前缀，前缀函数直接保留这段已知信息。

derivation: π[i]为截至i的前缀的最长真前后缀长度，真前缀排除整串。
失配时令j=π[j−1]，不断缩短候选；每次前进和回退摊还线性。

calculation.scenario: 模式abab，求π及在ababab中的匹配。
steps: 首个匹配从0开始，保留长度2后继续，第二个从2开始。
calculation.result: 重叠匹配不会因重置为0而丢失。

application.scenario: 流式日志匹配固定关键词。
steps: 预处理关键词π，块与块之间保留当前j。
每字符更新状态并在j达到模式长度时报告位置再回退。
application.result: 块边界不能清空状态，否则漏跨块匹配。

transfer.question: 模式aaaa的π是什么？
steps: 第2字符可复用a，长度1；第3复用aa，长度2。
第4复用aaa，长度3。
transfer.answer: π=[0,1,2,3]，不能把整串长度4当真前缀。

blocks.text: KMP searches for one pattern using a prefix function that records how much already matched text can be reused after a mismatch. A proper prefix excludes the whole string.

For pattern position i, π[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix equal to a suffix of the prefix ending at i. After mismatch, fall back through π rather than restarting the text scan. Standard matching takes O(n+m) for text length n and pattern length m.

For pattern abab, the prefix-function array is [0,0,1,2]. In text ababab, matches overlap: after a full match, the suffix ab can serve as the matched prefix for the next candidate, without rescanning those letters.

depth.boundary: Prefix-function values are lengths. Specify overlap handling after matches and the empty-pattern convention.

introduction.definition: Aho–Corasick把多个模式放进前缀树，并用失败链接复用后缀，一次扫描同时找很多词。
introduction.example: 检查一句话是否出现多个关键词，不必为每个词完整重扫一遍。

exercise.question: 文本she为什么应该同时匹配he？
exercise.answer: he是she的后缀，失败或输出链接保留该模式的结束信息。

derivation: 前缀树状态表示当前匹配前缀，失败链接指向最长可用真后缀状态。
输出既含本节点结束的模式，也含失败链上结束的模式；扫描成本还需加输出数。

calculation.scenario: 2个模式he、she，长度3的文本she。
steps: 沿s→sh→she，到she输出she。
she的失败链接指向he，继承输出he。
calculation.result: 得到she起点0、he起点1两个匹配。

application.scenario: 多关键词内容扫描。
steps: 建立一次自动机，多篇文本分别从根开始扫描。
明确大小写和Unicode规范化规则，并限制报告过多匹配的资源。
application.result: 匹配结果只表示字面出现，语境判定另做。

transfer.question: 只输出当前节点模式会怎样？
steps: 在she终点只报she。
后缀he会漏掉。
transfer.answer: 必须沿输出链接或预先继承输出集合。

blocks.text: Aho–Corasick searches many patterns together using a trie, failure links and output information. Trie prefixes share work; failure links represent a useful suffix when the next transition is missing.

Build the trie for total pattern length M and failure links in breadth-first order. Scan text through transitions and failure links, reporting outputs at reached states. With an appropriate transition representation, scan cost is O(n+z), where z is the number of reported matches.

For patterns he, she and hers, the trie shares the prefix he between he and hers. Reading she can report both she and its suffix he through output/failure information. This differs from KMP’s single-pattern prefix table.

depth.boundary: State the transition implementation and include the actual number of reported matches in complexity.

introduction.definition: LIS的tails方法给每种长度保留能实现的最小结尾，结尾越小越方便后续延长；它求长度不直接保存完整序列。
introduction.example: 接龙时相同长度下保留较小尾牌，就给后续牌留下更多选择。

exercise.question: 相同长度接龙为何留小尾牌？
exercise.answer: 未来能接在大尾牌后的牌也能接小尾牌，小尾不会减少延长机会。

derivation: 严格递增时，对每个x找tails中首个≥x的位置替换。
找不到则追加，tails长度即LIS长度，二分使总时间O(n log n)。

steps: 第二个2替换已有2，4追加成[1,2,4]。
calculation.result: 严格LIS长度3，不把相等2重复计数。

application.scenario: 求最大嵌套信封数。
steps: 宽度升序、同宽高度降序排序。
对高度求严格LIS，避免同宽信封被同时选。
application.result: 排序规则是从二维约束归约到一维的关键。

transfer.question: 若改求非递减子序列呢？
steps: 改找首个>x的位置，允许相等2追加。
transfer.answer: 长度4，比较符号改变问题定义。

blocks.text: The tails method finds the length of a longest strictly increasing subsequence. tails[k] is the smallest achievable ending value of an increasing subsequence of length k+1 among processed inputs.

For each x, replace the first tails value greater than or equal to x, or append if none exists. Binary search gives O(n log n). tails is a summary of best endpoints, not necessarily one actual subsequence; reconstruction needs predecessor information.
Processing [3,1,2] changes tails from [3] to [1] to [1,2], so the length is 2. The strict version uses the first value ≥x; choosing the first value >x instead addresses a nondecreasing variant.

depth.boundary: tails need not itself be a subsequence of the input. Reconstruction requires additional predecessor information.

introduction.definition: 带权区间调度选互不冲突的任务使总收益最大；收益不同，最早结束贪心可能失效。
introduction.example: 两小时赚100的任务，可能优于先接一小时赚1导致后面不能接的大单。

exercise.question: 带权任务为何不能只选最早结束？
exercise.answer: 早结束可能收益很低且阻挡高收益任务，需要比较总权重而非任务数。

derivation: 按结束时间排序，p(i)为与i兼容的最后任务，约定结束≤开始可兼容。
dp[i]=max(dp[i−1],w[i]+dp[p(i)])，分别不选或选i。

steps: 只选A和B得11。
C收益12，dp最优max(11,12)=12。
calculation.result: 不能用任务数量最多替代权重最优。

application.scenario: 安排收费会议室。
steps: 按清场时间修正每项实际结束，再二分兼容前驱。
计算dp并保存选择，逆向恢复预约列表。
application.result: 收益和时间约束共同决定安排。

transfer.question: 若C收益改为10呢？
steps: A+B仍11。
transfer.answer: 最优变为A和B；状态转移无需改变。

blocks.text: Weighted interval scheduling selects nonoverlapping intervals to maximize total weight. Sorting by finish time makes the final selected interval support a useful recurrence.

Let p(i) be the last earlier interval compatible with interval i, and w_i its weight. Then DP[i]=max(DP[i-1],w_i+DP[p(i)]), with DP[0]=0. Define endpoint compatibility explicitly; binary search can compute predecessor indices.
Suppose A=[0,2] has weight 4, B=[2,4] weight 5 and C=[0,4] weight 8, allowing touching endpoints. A+B earns 9 and beats C. Choosing the highest individual weight first would miss this result.

depth.boundary: Maximizing task count differs from maximizing reward; earliest-finish greedy does not apply unconditionally.

introduction.definition: 区间动态规划给连续一段定义答案，把大区间按分割点组合成小区间答案；端点和合并费用必须明确。
introduction.example: 先合并相邻小堆，再合成大堆，合并顺序不同会产生不同总费用。

exercise.question: 三堆合并为何要比较第一步顺序？
exercise.answer: 每次费用按当前合并重量计，不同顺序重复计入的重量不同。

derivation: 相邻合并代价为该段总重量，dp[l,r]存闭区间合并最小成本。
dp[l,r]=min_k(dp[l,k]+dp[k+1,r])+sum(l,r)，单项成本0，按长度递增。

steps: 先合1与2成本3，再合总6，总9。
先合2与3成本5，再合6，总11。
calculation.result: 最小9，分割点枚举覆盖两种最后切分。

application.scenario: 优化矩阵连乘括号。
steps: dp保存子链最少标量乘法，分割k后加两侧结果相乘的维度成本。
记录最优k回溯括号，不实际改变乘积次序。
application.result: 只改变结合顺序，不能交换矩阵。

transfer.question: 把重量改为[3,2,1]，最优多少？
steps: 先合2与1成本3，再合6，总9。
transfer.answer: 最优值仍9，但最优第一步位置反转。

blocks.text: Interval dynamic programming stores an answer for a contiguous range and builds larger ranges from smaller ones. The state must specify exactly which endpoints belong to the interval.

In matrix-chain multiplication, DP[l,r] is the minimum scalar multiplication count for matrices l through r. Its recurrence is \(DP[l,r]=\min_{l\le k<r}(DP[l,k]+DP[k+1,r]+d_{l-1}d_kd_r)\). Matrix i has dimensions \(d_{i-1}\times d_i\); a single matrix needs zero multiplications.

For matrices 10×30, 30×5 and 5×60, multiplying the first two first costs 1,500+3,000=4,500. Multiplying the last two first costs 9,000+18,000=27,000. The interval state compares both parenthesizations.

depth.boundary: The task determines the merge cost; one interval template does not fit every problem.

introduction.definition: 位掩码动态规划用二进制位表示已选集合，把“已处理哪些对象”纳入状态，适合对象数较少的指数问题。
introduction.example: 三盏灯用三位0/1表示开关状态，101代表第0和第2盏开着。

exercise.question: 101表示三盏灯中哪几盏？
exercise.answer: 按第0位为最低位约定，第0和第2盏开，第1盏关。

derivation: 路径状态dp[mask][v]表示恰访问mask内节点并结束于v的最小成本。
转移到未访问u：新mask=mask或(1左移u)，成本加边(v,u)；约O(n²2^n)。

calculation.result: 最优7，最终需加回起点边，不仅看访问完的状态。

application.scenario: 小规模任务分配。
steps: mask记录已占任务，当前工人数由位数得到。
向每个未占任务转移，加当前工人的相应费用。
application.result: 共享重复子问题，但没有把指数复杂度变成多项式。

transfer.question: n从10变20，mask数量增多少？
transfer.answer: 还未计每状态转移，规模限制必须提前估算。

blocks.text: Result and explanation: The optimal tour costs 21. Bitmask DP shares subproblems in O(n²2ⁿ) time; it does not make the problem polynomial in size.

worked.title: Bitmask DP: Remember the Last Node Too
worked.scenario: Four nodes 0…3 have directed distance matrix [[0,2,9,10],[1,0,6,4],[15,7,0,8],[6,3,12,0]]. Start at 0, visit every other node once, then return to 0.
steps: A state needs both the visited set and the last node: the next edge’s cost depends on the endpoint, even for the same visited set.
For example, 0→2→3 costs 9+8=17. Continuing to 1 and then 0 adds 3+1.
The full tour 0→2→3→1→0 costs 21. Checking the other five visitation orders confirms none is cheaper.
worked.result: The optimal tour costs 21. Bitmask DP shares subproblems in O(n²2ⁿ) time; it does not make the problem polynomial in size.
worked.pitfall: Omitting the return edge solves a different path problem. With asymmetric distances, reversing a tour need not give an equivalent route.
worked.question: Is one minimum value per visited set sufficient, without its endpoint?
worked.answer: No. Different endpoints have different continuation costs. A locally cheaper state may not yield the globally optimal tour.

depth.boundary: Bitmasks do not remove the exponential state count, and language integer widths are limited.

introduction.definition: 答案二分把优化问题改成“给定阈值能否做到”，前提是可行性随阈值单调。
introduction.example: 装箱容量越大越容易装下，找到刚刚足够的容量而不逐个试。

exercise.question: 容量越大越容易装，为什么适合二分？
exercise.answer: 可行性一旦成立，对更大容量仍成立，形成单调真假边界。

derivation: 维护不可行下界与可行上界，每次检查中点。
最小可行问题：中点可行缩上界，否则升下界，直到整数边界相邻。

calculation.scenario: 按顺序包裹[2,3,4]，两天运完，每天容量相同。
steps: 容量4需3天；容量5可分[2,3]与[4]，需2天。
容量越大所需天数不增，故最小容量5。
calculation.result: 先证明判定单调，再谈二分复杂度。

application.scenario: 求任务工期上限。
steps: 给定工期用独立判定器检查是否能排完。
验证极端上下界和整数溢出，以lo+(hi−lo)/2取中点。
application.result: 若判定器本身错，二分再快也无效。

transfer.question: 若改为一天运完，最小容量多少？
steps: 必须把2+3+4全部放入一天。
所需容量9，8不可行。
transfer.answer: 条件改变后答案为9，单调性仍成立。

sections.title: Exchange Arguments: Show How to Replace an Optimal Solution’s First Choice

blocks.text: An exchange argument shows that some optimal solution can be transformed into an equally good one beginning with the greedy choice. To maximize the number of compatible unweighted intervals, choose an interval with the earliest finish. Replacing an optimal solution’s first interval with this one leaves at least as much room for later intervals.

Once tasks have different benefits, machines have multiple resource constraints, or preemption methods are allowed to change, the original proof may no longer hold. Giving counterexamples during the interview can better demonstrate your understanding of the goals and constraints than just memorizing a "common greedy rule".

sections.title: Binary Search on the Answer: Feasibility Is Monotonic

blocks.text: Binary search applies beyond sorted arrays. Given a candidate bound B, suppose you can test whether any solution satisfies it, and feasibility changes monotonically with B. Then search for the boundary between infeasible and feasible candidates.

For example, split nonnegative tasks into at most k groups in their original order to minimize the maximum group sum. The lower bound is the largest individual value and the upper bound is the total sum. A larger B relaxes the constraint. Maintain explicit search boundaries rather than returning the first feasible candidate encountered.

sections.title: Feasibility check: Applicable prerequisites for grouped greedy

blocks.text: Given the upper limit, try to put the next item into the current group from left to right, and only open a new group if it cannot be placed. Non-negative numbers make "adding later does not reduce the current group sum" true, so this check can calculate the minimum number of groups required.

If negative numbers are allowed, the current overrun may be offset by subsequent negative terms, and the argument for early group cutting becomes invalid. If exactly k non-empty groups are required, non-negative and k does not exceed n, the larger group can be continued to be split without increasing the maximum sum; other constraints need to be re-argued.

sections.title: Numerical Search and Expression of Complexity

blocks.text: For an integer search interval of width U, O(n) work per feasibility check gives O(n log(U+1)) time and potentially O(1) auxiliary space. Here the logarithmic parameter is the answer range, not the number of input elements.

Floating-point answers require error or iteration number conventions; midpoint calculations must consider overflow, and termination conditions must be consistent with interval conventions. Don't write a fixed-precision decimal search directly as left=mid+1, and don't ignore the integer precision determined by the input range.

worked.title: Binary Search on the Answer: Test a Candidate Limit
worked.scenario: Keep nonnegative tasks [7,2,5,10,8] in order. Split them into at most 2 nonempty contiguous groups, minimizing the largest group sum.
steps: The answer is at least the largest item, 10, and at most the total, 32.
Limit 17 permits [7,2,5] with sum 14, then [10], but the final 8 requires a third group. It is infeasible.
Limit 18 permits [7,2,5] and [10,8]. Binary search finds the smallest feasible limit, 18.
worked.result: The optimal largest group sum is 18, splitting between 5 and 10. Each check costs O(n); integer search takes about O(n log U).
worked.pitfall: The greedy check requires nonnegative values. With negatives, a later item can reduce a temporarily excessive sum, so the same check is invalid.
worked.question: What is the answer if at most one group is allowed?
worked.answer: 32. All tasks must remain together.

depth.boundary: Prove any greedy feasibility test independently; constraints such as negative values can change the argument.

introduction.definition: 蓄水池抽样只保留固定数量样本，也能从长度未知的数据流中等概率抽取。
introduction.example: 只留一个样本，依次读取A、B、C。

exercise.question: 最后一个C一定最容易留下吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，正确算法让三者最终概率都为1/3。

derivation: 第i项以1/i概率替换当前样本，旧项留下需连续躲过后续替换。
旧项概率(1/(i−1))×(1−1/i)=1/i，新项也是1/i，归纳证明均匀。

calculation.scenario: 只留一个样本，依次读取A、B、C。
steps: 先保留A；读B时以1/2替换，读C时以1/3替换。

application.scenario: 从无法全部存下的日志流抽一个审查样本。
steps: 为每条有效记录递增计数，并用均匀随机整数决定替换。
保存样本及计数，若需可重现则保存随机状态；不能只随机取开头一段。
application.result: 保存样本及计数，若需可重现则保存随机状态；不能只随机取开头一段。

transfer.question: 第四项D到来后，A被保留的概率多少？
steps: A原概率1/3，避开D替换概率3/4。
乘积1/4，与B、C、D相同。
transfer.answer: 乘积1/4，与B、C、D相同。

blocks.text: 蓄水池抽样在不知道最终数据流长度时，用固定容量保留一个均匀随机子样本。它解决抽样问题；Bloom filter 解决近似成员查询，定义不再从后者页面重复搬来。
容量为 k，先保存前 k 个观测。第 t>k 个观测到来时，从 1 到 t 等概率抽整数 j；若 j≤k，就替换池中第 j 个，否则保持。处理到 t 时，每个原观测被保留的概率都是 k/t，空间为 O(k)。
容量 k=1，先保存 A；B 到来时以 1/2 概率替换，C 到来时以 1/3 概率替换。最终 A 的保留概率为 (1/2)×(2/3)=1/3，B 也为 1/3，C 为 1/3。不能总用 1/2 替换，否则近期记录被过度保留。

worked.title: Reservoir Sampling: Every Position Ends with Probability One Third
worked.scenario: A,B,C arrive in a stream. Keep one sample, applying a position-dependent replacement probability.
steps: Keep A initially. B replaces it with probability 1/2.
C replaces the current sample with probability 1/3. A’s final retention probability is 1×1/2×2/3=1/3.
B’s final probability is 1/2×2/3=1/3. C’s final probability is 1/3.
worked.result: All three positions are equally likely to remain, without knowing the stream’s final length in advance.
worked.pitfall: Replacing with probability 1/2 every time favors later elements. Incorrect endpoints in uniform integer sampling also change probabilities.
worked.question: For records A,A,B, what is the probability that the retained value is A?
worked.answer: 2/3. Sampling is uniform over record positions. The two A records are distinct positions; values are not deduplicated first.

depth.boundary: Correct probabilities depend on uniform-index bounds and the definition of a sampling unit.

introduction.definition: 布隆过滤器用位标记快速判断“可能存在”或“肯定不存在”，允许误报但标准插入查询不漏报。
introduction.example: 8个位全为0，两个哈希把A映到1、3，把B映到2、3。

exercise.question: 两个查询位都为1就证明插入过吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，它们可能分别由别的键置位。

derivation: 插入把各哈希位置设1；查询若有一位0，该键不可能按相同规则插入过。
所有位1只说明未排除，哈希碰撞会误报，仍需查权威数据。

calculation.scenario: 8个位全为0，两个哈希把A映到1、3，把B映到2、3。
steps: 插入A、B后位1、2、3为1，其余0。
未插入的C若映到1、2，查询仍通过，形成一次误报。
calculation.result: 未插入的C若映到1、2，查询仍通过，形成一次误报。

application.scenario: 减少不存在键对数据库的无效读取。
steps: 先查询过滤器，否定时直接返回不存在，肯定时继续查询数据库。
新增数据同步更新过滤器并明确恢复规则，防止陈旧副本违反无漏报前提。
application.result: 新增数据同步更新过滤器并明确恢复规则，防止陈旧副本违反无漏报前提。

transfer.question: 删除A时直接清位1和3安全吗？
steps: 位3也由B使用，清掉后B查询看到0。
会产生漏报；普通布隆过滤器不能这样删除，应重建或使用计数变体。
transfer.answer: 会产生漏报；普通布隆过滤器不能这样删除，应重建或使用计数变体。

blocks.text: Bloom filter records bits with multiple hash positions. If the query finds that any bit is 0, it can be determined that it has not been inserted; if all are 1, it can only be said that it may exist, because different elements may set these bits together.

worked.title: Bloom Filters: Two Inserted Items Combine into a False Positive
worked.scenario: Start with 8 zero bits and two hash positions per item. A maps to [1,4], B to [4,6], and uninserted C to [1,6].
steps: Insert A by setting bits 1 and 4. Insert B by setting bits 4 and 6.
Both C positions are now 1, returning “possibly present,” although C was never inserted. This is a false positive.
Clearing shared bit 4 to delete A would make B encounter 0 and incorrectly appear absent.
worked.result: Shared bits provide compact storage, but cause false positives and prevent ordinary deletion. An exact record lookup can confirm membership.
worked.pitfall: This fixed, tiny bitmap illustrates the mechanism. It cannot establish a production system’s false-positive rate.
worked.question: If D maps to [0,6], what can be concluded?
worked.answer: Bit 0 remains 0. Under standard insertion-only operation with consistent hashes, D was definitely not inserted.

depth.boundary: Standard insert-only use has no false negatives. Directly clearing shared bits is not safe deletion.

introduction.definition: 摊还分析把一串操作的总成本分摊，说明偶尔昂贵不代表每次都昂贵。
introduction.example: 动态数组初始容量1，满时翻倍，连续追加4项，计写入和旧元素复制。

exercise.question: 摊还常数代表每次追加最坏也常数吗？
exercise.answer: 不代表，扩容那次仍需复制很多元素。

derivation: 扩容复制量形成1+2+4+…的几何级数，小于最终容量的两倍。
n次普通写入加O(n)复制，总O(n)，因此每次摊还O(1)，不需要随机假设。

calculation.scenario: 动态数组初始容量1，满时翻倍，连续追加4项，计写入和旧元素复制。
steps: 4次写入成本4，第二项扩容复制1，第三项扩容复制2。

application.scenario: 选择增长型消息缓存的数组策略。
steps: 使用几何扩容减少反复复制，并评估扩容时峰值内存与延迟。
若严格单次延迟预算不容扩容尖峰，应预分配或分块，而非把摊还界当延迟保证。
application.result: 若严格单次延迟预算不容扩容尖峰，应预分配或分块，而非把摊还界当延迟保证。

transfer.question: 继续追加到8项，总成本多少？
steps: 8次写入，加扩容复制1+2+4=7。
总15，平均15/8=1.875，虽第5项很贵但整串仍线性。
transfer.answer: 总15，平均15/8=1.875，虽第5项很贵但整串仍线性。

blocks.text: Worst-case analysis focuses on the most expensive case among allowed inputs; expectation analysis must explain whether the randomness comes from the algorithm or the input model; amortized analysis allocates the total cost of a series of operations to each operation and does not require random inputs.

worked.title: Dynamic Arrays: Amortizing Expensive Growth
worked.scenario: Initial capacity is 1 and doubles when full. Append 8 elements, ignoring allocator overhead.
steps: Growing to capacities 2,4,8 copies 1,2,4 existing elements respectively: 7 copies in total.
Eight writes plus seven copies give 15 units of work. One append can be expensive, but total work is still proportional to 8.
A ninth append grows capacity to 16 and copies 8 elements. Total copies become 15 and total work 24, still below 3×9.
worked.result: With geometric capacity growth, a geometric series bounds n appends by O(n) total work, giving O(1) amortized cost per append.
worked.pitfall: Amortized O(1) does not mean worst-case O(1) for every append. Growing by one slot each time instead copies 1+2+…+(n-1) elements.
worked.question: Can old storage be ignored immediately during growth?
worked.answer: No. Old and new arrays can coexist during copying. Analyze peak memory and reclamation separately.

depth.boundary: Amortized analysis is not expected analysis over random inputs and does not make every operation cheap.

introduction.definition: 精确十进制用整数和小数位数表示金额，避免二进制浮点近似，还须遵守接口允许的金额步长。
introduction.example: 金额“10.25”，用两位小数整数表示。

exercise.question: 能表示两位小数就代表接口允许任意分数金额吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，例如Stripe的ISK接口仍只允许整克朗金额。

derivation: 值=m/10ˢ，提高位数乘10的幂；降低位数若不许舍入，必须整除。
表示精度与合法最小金额是两条约束，先精确换算再检查币种与操作规则。

calculation.scenario: 金额“10.25”，用两位小数整数表示。
steps: 换到一位需1025除10但余5，不能无损转换，应拒绝或使用明确舍入规则。
calculation.result: 换到一位需1025除10但余5，不能无损转换，应拒绝或使用明确舍入规则。

application.scenario: 生成Stripe的10 ISK收费金额。
steps: 按该接口两位表示得到1000，再检查1000可被100整除。
金额表达合法；最低收费、账户与支付方式约束还需独立检查。
application.result: 金额表达合法；最低收费、账户与支付方式约束还需独立检查。

transfer.question: 10.25 ISK转成1025后可以直接收费吗？
steps: 1025除100余25，不是整ISK。
不能，该规则禁止分数ISK，精确表示不等于业务合法。
transfer.answer: 不能，该规则禁止分数ISK，精确表示不等于业务合法。

blocks.text: Represent a value as m/10^s. To increase the scale, multiply m by a power of ten. To reduce it without rounding, require the discarded digits to be zero. Decimal-string operations can implement this conversion without a binary floating-point intermediate.

Keep the representation scale separate from the allowed amount quantum. Stripe represents ISK with two decimal places but permits only whole-ISK charges; HUF and TWD manual payouts similarly require minor-unit integers divisible by 100.
例子：12.30 可表示为整数 1230 与 scale=2。与 0.45 相加，先统一精度得到 1275/100=12.75；若改为 scale=1，1230/100 只能在相应整除条件下精确改写。金额取整必须明确规则，不能靠显示两位小数代替。

depth.boundary: Representation scale and allowed increments can differ by operation. Input grammar, precision, and divisibility need separate checks. Integer storage must be wide enough; arbitrary-precision arithmetic does not have constant cost for unbounded digit counts.

introduction.definition: 密码哈希把任意字节串映成固定长度摘要；相同内容应得到相同摘要，但摘要本身不是加密。
introduction.example: Dropbox对5 MiB文件按4 MiB固定块分别做SHA-256，再对块摘要拼接做SHA-256。

exercise.question: 网络每次传1 MiB就应每次结束一个哈希块吗？
exercise.answer: 不应，传输分块与内容哈希规定的4 MiB块不同。

derivation: 普通增量哈希分批更新等价于哈希字节拼接；Dropbox另明确规定了两层块摘要结构。
外层接收原始32字节摘要，而非64个十六进制字符，否则结果改变。

calculation.scenario: Dropbox对5 MiB文件按4 MiB固定块分别做SHA-256，再对块摘要拼接做SHA-256。
steps: 5 MiB分为4 MiB和1 MiB两块，得到两个32字节摘要。
外层哈希输入64字节，最终32字节摘要显示为64个十六进制字符。
calculation.result: 外层哈希输入64字节，最终32字节摘要显示为64个十六进制字符。

application.scenario: 流式校验Dropbox上传文件内容。
steps: 累计字节到4,194,304时结束内层块，摘要原始字节交给外层，再重置内层。
EOF仅结束非空残块，最终比较外层摘要，网络分片大小不影响结果。
application.result: EOF仅结束非空残块，最终比较外层摘要，网络分片大小不影响结果。

transfer.question: 文件恰好4 MiB，EOF还要追加空块吗？
steps: 完整块已结束并贡献一个32字节摘要，残留字节数为0。
不追加空块；外层只接收该32字节，空文件则直接哈希空的外层输入。
transfer.answer: 不追加空块；外层只接收该32字节，空文件则直接哈希空的外层输入。

blocks.text: Dropbox content_hash first hashes each 4,194,304-byte block with SHA-256, then hashes the concatenation of the raw 32-byte block digests. Only the final digest is encoded as hexadecimal. Transport chunk boundaries do not change the fixed block boundaries.

Keep one inner hash context, one outer context, and a block-byte counter. Finalize every full block and any remaining nonempty block. An empty file contributes no inner block; an exact block multiple must not append an empty block.
例子：文件分成两个块，各自 SHA-256 得到 32 字节摘要 A、B。组合散列应对 64 个原始摘要字节求哈希；把 A、B 各转成 64 字符十六进制后再拼接，会变成另一组输入，不能得到同一个分块内容散列。

depth.boundary: Dropbox content_hash differs from SHA-256 applied directly to the file. Hash-table indexing, content identification, and authentication have different requirements. Digest equality is subject to collision assumptions and does not by itself authenticate a sender.

introduction.definition: 用户看到的一个字符可能由多个Unicode标量组成，也可能编码成多个字节。
introduction.example: 字符串由e、组合尖音符、A组成，看起来是“éA”。

exercise.question: 它是3个用户可见字符吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，前两个标量组成一个字素簇，总共2个可见字符。

derivation: UTF-8按编码单位计字节，字素分割按Unicode字符边界规则组合标量。
要保完整字符的字节前缀，应逐字素累计其UTF-8长度，超过预算前停止。

calculation.scenario: 字符串由e、组合尖音符、A组成，看起来是“éA”。
steps: e占1字节，组合尖音符占2字节，A占1字节，总4字节。
字节预算3保留完整“é”，预算2则连第一个字素都放不下，返回空前缀。
calculation.result: 字节预算3保留完整“é”，预算2则连第一个字素都放不下，返回空前缀。

application.scenario: 限制昵称UTF-8长度且不拆开表情或组合字符。
steps: 使用Unicode感知的字素遍历器，逐个测编码字节长度。
截取完整前缀并保存所用规范化规则，不能用字节切片替代字符边界。
application.result: 截取完整前缀并保存所用规范化规则，不能用字节切片替代字符边界。

transfer.question: 若先把“é”规范化为单标量“é”，字节数还一样吗？
steps: 预组合é的UTF-8为2字节，后面A再1字节。
总变3字节但仍2个字素；是否规范化应由接口约定，不能悄悄改变原文。
transfer.answer: 总变3字节但仍2个字素；是否规范化应由接口约定，不能悄悄改变原文。

blocks.text: The decomposed string e followed by a combining acute accent contains two Unicode scalars but one grapheme cluster and three UTF-8 bytes. A multi-scalar emoji can also form one Character.

For a byte-limited prefix that preserves characters, visit whole grapheme clusters in order and accumulate each cluster's UTF-8 length. Stop before the next cluster would exceed the budget. Segmentation should use a Unicode-aware library rather than byte slicing.
例子：“é”可由一个码点表示，也可由 e 加组合重音组成；后者有两个 Unicode 标量，但用户通常把它视为一个字形簇。按 UTF-8 字节截断还可能破坏编码；限制“10 个可见字符”需先明确计数单位。

depth.boundary: Counting characters does not give a byte length. Canonically equivalent text can have different byte sequences. The segmentation version and normalization policy are part of an interoperable text-processing contract.

introduction.definition: 背压让消费者表达还接得下多少数据，生产方按约定限制发送，避免处理队列无限增长。
introduction.example: Combine订阅者先请求2项，PassthroughSubject依次发送A、B、C。

exercise.question: receive返回none会取消剩余需求吗？
exercise.answer: 不会，它只是不增加额外需求。

derivation: 有限需求每交付一项消耗一个额度，显式请求与receive返回的需求都增加额度。
PassthroughSubject不为未来需求保存值，零需求时该订阅者会错过当前发送值。

calculation.scenario: Combine订阅者先请求2项，PassthroughSubject依次发送A、B、C。
steps: A消耗一个额度，剩1；B再消耗一个，剩0。
C在零需求时被该订阅者丢弃，共交付2项，不是排队等以后补发。
calculation.result: C在零需求时被该订阅者丢弃，共交付2项，不是排队等以后补发。

application.scenario: 订阅者每次只能处理一个昂贵图像任务。
steps: 先请求1项，完成处理后再追加需求，并选择明确的缓冲或丢弃策略。
确认上游真实遵守需求；任意外部设备不一定能被背压暂停。
application.result: 确认上游真实遵守需求；任意外部设备不一定能被背压暂停。

transfer.question: 后来再请求1项，会补交刚才C吗？
steps: PassthroughSubject没有缓存C。
不会；之后发送D才可消耗新增额度并交付D。
transfer.answer: 不会；之后发送D才可消耗新增额度并交付D。

blocks.text: With finite demand, each delivered element consumes one credit. Explicit requests and the additional demand returned by receive add credits; returning none adds zero and does not cancel existing demand.

A PassthroughSubject does not buffer values for later demand. With one subscriber and zero demand, a sent value is dropped for that subscriber. Other publishers and buffering operators can have different policies.
例子：订阅者先请求 3 个元素，生产者依次交付后，需求余额为 2、1、0。在余额为零时继续交付，违反这份需求契约；缓冲、暂停上游或拒绝请求属于另行明确的处理策略。

depth.boundary: Demand limits deliveries rather than elapsed-time request rate. Unlimited demand, cancellation, reentrant sends, multiple subscribers, and completion require their own protocol rules.

applications.title: Adaptive Concurrency · 服务并发上限的反馈控制
applications.reason: 复用背压的供需关系，单独解释服务如何根据延迟反馈调整在途请求上限。

applications.title: Backpressure · 行情与交易消息的拥塞控制
applications.reason: 将一般背压用于行情新鲜度、交易回报完整性和拥塞时的风险降级。

introduction.definition: 最大最小公平先照顾较小且未满足的分配，不能靠压低更小者来增加更大者。
introduction.example: 单一可分资源容量12，三个等权需求上限2、8、8。

exercise.question: 公平意味着三者必须都分4吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，第一位只需2，多余应分给仍有需求者。

derivation: 同水位λ分配xᵢ=min(dᵢ,λ)，总分配为min(C,Σd)。
逐步注水，碰到小需求上限就移出共享集合，再均分剩余容量。

calculation.scenario: 单一可分资源容量12，三个等权需求上限2、8、8。
steps: 初始均分12/3=4，需求2先满足，剩容量10。

application.scenario: 给三个租户分配可分CPU配额。
steps: 按需求上限排序，用剩余容量除活跃租户数决定水位。
验证不超过需求、总量不超容量；多资源或带权公平需要扩展模型。
application.result: 验证不超过需求、总量不超容量；多资源或带权公平需要扩展模型。

transfer.question: 容量改20，需求仍2、8、8呢？
steps: 总需求只有18，所有人需求均可满足。
分配[2,8,8]，剩2空闲，不强塞超过需求的资源。
transfer.answer: 分配[2,8,8]，剩2空闲，不强塞超过需求的资源。

blocks.text: For capacity C >= 0 and demands d_i >= 0, allocate x_i = min(d_i, lambda), choosing a common water level so the total is min(C, sum d_i). A demand-capped consumer leaves the sharing set when its cap is reached.

Sort demands, satisfy the smallest cap when it is no greater than the remaining equal share, then divide the remaining capacity equally among active consumers. Sorting costs O(n log(n + 1)) time; the subsequent scan is linear.

depth.boundary: This formula assumes equal weights and one divisible resource, without reservations, placement constraints, or indivisible jobs. Peloton's hierarchical, weighted, multi-resource scheduler has additional policies.

distinctions.title: Risk Parity · 风险平价
distinctions.reason: 最大最小公平分配保护较小的未满足分配；风险平价约束组合风险贡献。目标、单位与约束不同。

concepts.title: Adaptive Concurrency · 服务并发上限的反馈控制

introduction.definition: 自适应并发限制根据服务实际延迟与拥塞反馈，调整同时在途的请求上限。
introduction.example: 上限L=10，空载延迟R₀=10毫秒，观察R=20毫秒，教学规则为估算排队大于3则上限减1。

exercise.question: 延迟变大就证明服务器一定需要更多并发吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，可能已经排队，增加并发反而更慢。

derivation: Vegas式估算q=ceil(L(1−R₀/R))，用相对基线的额外耗时近似排队。
示例固定基线并规定q>3减1、q=0加1、其余保持；真实实现还有利用率、丢弃、边界和平滑。

calculation.scenario: 上限L=10，空载延迟R₀=10毫秒，观察R=20毫秒，教学规则为估算排队大于3则上限减1。
steps: 5大于3，按教学规则上限从10降到9；不是Netflix全部策略的精确复刻。
calculation.result: 5大于3，按教学规则上限从10降到9；不是Netflix全部策略的精确复刻。

application.scenario: 保护负载变化大的远程服务。
steps: 从保守上限开始测延迟，过滤错误样本并周期探测无拥塞基线。
统一管理在途许可并设最小最大值，用真实错误率检验稳定性。
application.result: 统一管理在途许可并设最小最大值，用真实错误率检验稳定性。

transfer.question: 仍L=10，若R降到10毫秒，示例如何更新？
steps: 按q=0加1规则升到11，但仍须服从配置上限及实际利用率条件。
transfer.answer: 按q=0加1规则升到11，但仍须服从配置上限及实际利用率条件。

blocks.text: 自适应并发限制器根据已经观察到的服务延迟、利用率或丢弃等反馈，调整同时在途的请求数。它把背压落到请求入口，目的是控制排队；并发上限是请求数，不能当作每秒请求速率。
在本页讨论的固定基线教学口径中，上限为 L、无排队基线延迟为 R₀、当前延迟为 R，且 R≥R₀>0，排队量估计为 \(\widehat q=\lceil L(1-R_0/R)\rceil\)。这只是反馈信号，不能单凭它推断真实队列。实际更新还要声明阈值、平滑、上下界和基线探测规则，不能凭公式臆造完整控制策略。
L=20、R₀=10 毫秒、R=20 毫秒时，估计排队量为 10。控制器可以按事先设定的策略降低后续准入，但已经进入系统的请求不会因此消失。若 R₀ 失真，估计也会失真；处理时间较长与排队较多需要额外观测来区分。

depth.boundary: The queue estimate is a model, not a measured count of waiting requests. A concurrency cap is distinct from a request-rate quota. This pinned open-source implementation does not establish Netflix's current production configuration.

distinctions.title: Token Bucket / Rate Limiting
distinctions.reason: 令牌桶控制准入速率与突发额度；并发限制控制同时在途数量。相同请求速率可对应不同并发。

introduction.definition: SQL聚合把行归成组计算数量或总量；先认清连接后每行代表什么，避免重复计数。
introduction.example: 客户A有2笔订单，客户B无订单，对客户左连接订单。

exercise.question: COUNT(*)一定等于订单数吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，左连接为无订单客户也保留一行。

derivation: COUNT(*)数全部行，COUNT(order_id)忽略NULL；一对多连接会复制客户字段。
按稳定客户ID分组，计算百分比时明确分母并用非整数除法。

calculation.scenario: 客户A有2笔订单，客户B无订单，对客户左连接订单。
steps: 连接生成A的两行和B的一行，共3行。
COUNT(*)=3、COUNT(order_id)=2；分客户订单数分别2、0。
calculation.result: COUNT(*)=3、COUNT(order_id)=2；分客户订单数分别2、0。

application.scenario: 统计每位客户订单额并保留未下单客户。
steps: 从客户表左连接订单，按客户ID聚合，用COALESCE处理无订单时的空和。
若再连订单明细，应先聚合到正确粒度，避免同一订单总额被重复累加。
application.result: 若再连订单明细，应先聚合到正确粒度，避免同一订单总额被重复累加。

transfer.question: A两笔订单金额10、20，每笔各2条明细，再直接求订单金额和会多少？
steps: 两笔金额都重复两遍，得到10+10+20+20=60。
真实订单和30，应先按订单去除连接重复或分层聚合，不能用错误粒度的60。
transfer.answer: 真实订单和30，应先按订单去除连接重复或分层聚合，不能用错误粒度的60。

blocks.text: COUNT(*) counts rows, COUNT(expression) ignores NULL values, and COUNT(DISTINCT expression) counts distinct nonnull values. A left join creates a NULL-filled row for an unmatched parent; a one-to-many join can repeat each parent's values.

Group by stable identifiers when different entities can share a name. To return every maximum, compare each result with the maximum aggregate rather than selecting one arbitrary row. Compute percentages with the intended denominator and real-valued division; use ORDER BY when output order matters.
例子：左表两个用户，右表只有用户 A 的两条订单。LEFT JOIN 后有三行，COUNT(*)=3，而 COUNT(order_id)=2。若业务要求用户数，应按用户标识计数；不能把联接后的行数直接解释成用户数。

depth.boundary: SQL does not promise row order without ORDER BY. Empty groups, NULL, duplicate join matches, and tied maxima need explicit contracts. Logical query semantics do not determine whether an engine uses hashing, sorting, or an index.

introduction.definition: MapReduce把同键数据汇总；组合器先在本地压缩摘要，减少传输，但必须保持最终结果。
introduction.example: 分片A有[2,4]，分片B只有[10]，求总体均值。

exercise.question: 直接平均两个分片均值3和10对吗？
exercise.answer: 不对，分片大小不同，应保留各自样本数。

derivation: 均值可合并摘要为(sum,count)，合并时分别相加，最终才做除法。
组合器可能被跳过或重复分层执行，局部合并必须对任意分组保持语义一致。

calculation.scenario: 分片A有[2,4]，分片B只有[10]，求总体均值。

application.scenario: 按城市汇总大量温度记录。
steps: Mapper发出城市与(sum,count)，本地combiner按城市先合并。
Reducer再次合并后除总样本数，空分片按恒等摘要(0,0)处理。
application.result: Reducer再次合并后除总样本数，空分片按恒等摘要(0,0)处理。

transfer.question: 若B改为[10,10]，正确均值多少？
steps: 均值26/4=6.5，这次等大分片的均值平均恰好成立，但不是一般规则。
transfer.answer: 均值26/4=6.5，这次等大分片的均值平均恰好成立，但不是一般规则。

blocks.text: For a mean, retain (sum, count), combine pairs componentwise, and divide once at the end. An unweighted average of worker means fails when partition sizes differ.

A combiner must preserve results when applied to different groupings, including when it is skipped. Associativity and commutativity are useful requirements for unordered aggregation; floating-point rounding still depends on evaluation order.
例子：分片一为 (0,10)，均值 5；分片二只有 (100)，均值 100。直接平均两个均值得 52.5，但正确整体均值为 110/3≈36.67。保存并合并 (sum,count) 可处理不同分片大小。

depth.boundary: Aggregation algebra does not by itself guarantee exactly-once side effects, deterministic floating-point results, or balanced partitions.

concepts.title: Mergeable Variance · 流式方差与分片合并

introduction.definition: 可合并方差用数量、均值和离均平方和概括一组数据，不存全部样本也能合并统计。

exercise.question: 直接平均两片方差能得到总体方差吗？
exercise.answer: 通常不能，会遗漏两片均值之间的差异。

derivation: 保存(n,μ,M₂)，M₂=Σ(x−μ)²；两片均值差δ时，合并μ=μA+δnB/n。
合并M₂=M₂A+M₂B+δ²nAnB/n，最后总体方差M₂/n，空摘要先单独处理。

application.scenario: 分布式计算传感器波动。
steps: 每个worker输出三元摘要，再用同一合并算子做树形归并。
声明总体或样本方差，浮点运算的合并顺序仍可能导致细小舍入差。
application.result: 声明总体或样本方差，浮点运算的合并顺序仍可能导致细小舍入差。

transfer.question: 同一数据若要求无偏样本方差，结果多少？
steps: M₂仍20，但分母从n=4改为n−1=3。
结果20/3≈6.6667；样本数1时不能计算该无偏估计。
transfer.answer: 结果20/3≈6.6667；样本数1时不能计算该无偏估计。

blocks.text: 可合并方差摘要是在流式计算或分布式分片中，保存样本数、均值和离均差平方和，再由这些摘要计算整体方差的方法。应用问题是数据怎样分批到达、摘要如何合并；总体方差和样本方差的定义仍使用共同的统计基础。

摘要为 (n, μ, M₂)，M₂ 是各观测与均值之差的平方和。合并非空摘要 A、B，令 \(n=n_A+n_B\)、\(\Delta=\mu_B-\mu_A\)，则 \(\mu=\mu_A+\Delta n_B/n\)，\(M_2=M_{2,A}+M_{2,B}+\Delta^2n_An_B/n\)。总体方差为 M₂/n；无偏样本方差为 M₂/(n−1)，要求 n>1。空摘要须先单独处理，不能除零。
分片 A 为 1、3，摘要是 (2,2,2)；B 为 5，摘要是 (1,5,0)。合并得均值 3、M₂=8，总体方差为 8/3，样本方差为 4。直接平均两片的方差会漏掉分片均值之间的差异。摘要只需固定大小存储，但浮点合并次序仍可能带来微小舍入差。

depth.boundary: Population variance and sample variance use different denominators. Empty input needs an explicit convention. Floating-point overflow and rounding remain possible, and different merge orders can produce slightly different results.

introduction.definition: 外部一致性让事务像依次执行，还尊重客户端已经观察到的先后关系。
introduction.example: T1在时刻10完成，T2在20开始、30完成，40发起当前强读。

exercise.question: 仅能排成某个串行顺序就必然尊重真实时间吗？
exercise.answer: 不必，外部一致性额外约束已完成事务必须先于后来开始者。

derivation: T1完成后T2才开始，故合法串行顺序必须T1在前、T2在后。
一致快照对应序列的某个前缀，不能只包含后来的T2却遗漏T1。

calculation.scenario: T1在时刻10完成，T2在20开始、30完成，40发起当前强读。
steps: 初始a=b=0，T1写a=1，T2写b=1。
40发起的当前强读应见(a,b)=(1,1)；只见(0,1)不符合该顺序。
calculation.result: 40发起的当前强读应见(a,b)=(1,1)；只见(0,1)不符合该顺序。

application.scenario: 客户提交配置更新后立即查询依赖该配置的事务结果。
steps: 等待更新提交后再启动后续事务，并使用相应强读语义。
若明确请求历史时间戳，则按历史快照解释，不把旧快照误判为当前强读故障。
application.result: 若明确请求历史时间戳，则按历史快照解释，不把旧快照误判为当前强读故障。

transfer.question: 若明确读取时刻15的历史快照，可以只见T1吗？
steps: 15晚于T1提交10，早于T2开始20。
可以见(1,0)，这是合法历史前缀；不代表当前读允许漏掉已提交T2。
transfer.answer: 可以见(1,0)，这是合法历史前缀；不代表当前读允许漏掉已提交T2。

blocks.text: Serializability requires equivalence to a serial transaction order. External consistency adds the order that clients can observe between non-overlapping transactions.

If T1 commits before T2 begins, a consistent snapshot cannot include T2's effects while omitting T1's. Strong reads started after both commits must reflect both; an explicitly historical snapshot can precede them.
例子：客户端已收到事务 T1 提交成功，随后才发起 T2，则外部一致的序列必须把 T1 放在 T2 前。两事务若实际重叠，未必有由客户端先后强制的顺序；不能把“可串行化”自动解释成遵守所有墙钟印象。

depth.boundary: Two independent reads are not automatically one snapshot. Clock timestamps alone do not establish a transaction consistency guarantee.

introduction.definition: 服务目标规定可接受成功率，错误预算是同一窗口内允许发生的失败额度。
introduction.example: 窗口内100万有效请求，成功目标99.9%，已失败400次。

exercise.question: 99.9%请求成功目标等同每月允许固定几分钟宕机吗？
exercise.answer: 不等，按请求和按时间计算的分母不同。

derivation: 允许失败N(1−S)，实际成功率1−B/N，预算用量为B/[N(1−S)]。
先固定有效事件、时间窗与测量位置，再计算；零请求或零预算须单独处理。

calculation.scenario: 窗口内100万有效请求，成功目标99.9%，已失败400次。

application.scenario: 为API服务决定近期发布节奏。
steps: 持续计算同口径坏事件与预算消耗，配合预定错误预算政策。
快速消耗时先控制故障与验证变更，不把预算当主动制造失败的额度。
application.result: 快速消耗时先控制故障与验证变更，不把预算当主动制造失败的额度。

transfer.question: 同一窗口失败变1200次，目标还满足吗？
steps: 实际成功99.88%，低于99.9%，该窗口违约。
transfer.answer: 实际成功99.88%，低于99.9%，该窗口违约。

blocks.text: For N > 0 eligible requests, B bad requests, and success target S, observed success is 1 − B/N and the allowed bad-event count is N(1 − S). Budget consumption is B/[N(1 − S)] when the denominator is positive.
Define eligible events, observation window, and measurement location before calculating the ratio. A request-based budget and a time-based availability budget have different denominators.
例子：窗口有 10000 个合格请求，成功目标 99.9%，允许坏事件数为 10。实际失败 6 次，预算消费 60%。若把超时请求从分母中删掉会改变指标契约，不能只为了让结果达标而排除它们。

depth.boundary: A request error fraction cannot be converted directly into outage duration. An SLO target alone is not an SLA with contractual consequences.

distinctions.title: Latency Budget · 延迟预算
distinctions.reason: 错误预算是目标窗口内允许的失败额度；延迟预算分配一次链路的耗时，不能混用预算单位。

introduction.definition: 令牌桶按固定速率补充额度，积累到上限后停止，既限制长期速率又允许有限突发。
introduction.example: 容量5，现有1个令牌，每秒补2个，过去1.5秒后收到3个单位请求。

exercise.question: 空闲很久后能无限突发吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，余额被桶容量限制。

derivation: 先补充b新=min(C,b+rΔt)，每获准一个请求扣1，额度不足则按策略拒绝或排队。
保留小数额度并更新时间，多线程或多副本共享限额需原子补充与扣减。

calculation.scenario: 容量5，现有1个令牌，每秒补2个，过去1.5秒后收到3个单位请求。
steps: 依次批准3个请求后剩1，不能每次都用旧时间重复补充。
calculation.result: 依次批准3个请求后剩1，不能每次都用旧时间重复补充。

application.scenario: 对外部接口设置每秒2次、最多突发5次的限流。
steps: 将令牌检查放在实际调用入口，用单调时钟计算经过时间。
拒绝时返回可重试信息或受控排队，避免无界积压。
application.result: 拒绝时返回可重试信息或受控排队，避免无界积压。

transfer.question: 若桶已满后瞬间来6个单位请求，无补充时间，能放行多少？
steps: 初始只有5个令牌，前5个依次扣到0。
第6个不能放行；多个独立副本各一桶不等于全局只放5个。
transfer.answer: 第6个不能放行；多个独立副本各一桶不等于全局只放5个。

blocks.text: For capacity C, rate r, elapsed time Δt, and previous credit b, refill to min(C, b + rΔt). Admit a unit-cost request only when this balance is at least one, then subtract one.
Retain fractional credit and update the timestamp on each refill. Shared buckets need atomic refill-and-consume decisions; independent replica buckets do not enforce one global quota.
例子：容量 5、补充速率每秒 2、当前余额 1，经过 2 秒后补到 min(5,1+4)=5。连续六个单位成本请求中可立即放行五个，第六个应按规则等待或拒绝；这不是对同时在途请求数的限制。

depth.boundary: Rate, concurrent in-flight work, and queue size are different limits. A token bucket is not a guarantee of uniform spacing between requests.

distinctions.title: Adaptive Concurrency · 服务并发上限的反馈控制
distinctions.reason: 令牌桶控制准入速率与突发额度；并发限制控制同时在途数量。相同请求速率可对应不同并发。

introduction.definition: 熔断器在依赖持续失败时暂时停止调用，过一段时间用少量试探确认是否恢复。
introduction.example: 教学规则为连续3次失败就打开，等待10秒后半开，只允许1个探测请求。

exercise.question: 打开熔断器等于修复了远程服务吗？
exercise.answer: 不是，它只阻止本地继续施压。

derivation: 关闭态允许调用并记录失败，打开态本地拒绝，半开态限制探测。
探测成功按规则关闭，失败重新打开；并发调用必须协调探测许可。

calculation.scenario: 教学规则为连续3次失败就打开，等待10秒后半开，只允许1个探测请求。
steps: 连续失败1、2、3次后进入打开态，第4次调用被本地拒绝。
等待10秒进入半开，只发送1个探测，其余请求仍受限。
calculation.result: 等待10秒进入半开，只发送1个探测，其余请求仍受限。

application.scenario: 保护支付服务不被故障下游拖垮。
steps: 按依赖分别配置失败窗口、超时与恢复规则，记录熔断状态。
返回明确降级结果，支付结果未知时仍需查单，不能把本地拒绝当退款成功。
application.result: 返回明确降级结果，支付结果未知时仍需查单，不能把本地拒绝当退款成功。

transfer.question: 半开探测再次失败会怎样？
steps: 按示例恢复规则立即重新打开，并重置等待计时。
继续限制流量而非恢复全部调用，避免一拥而上放大故障。
transfer.answer: 继续限制流量而非恢复全部调用，避免一拥而上放大故障。

blocks.text: Closed allows calls and records outcomes. Open rejects locally until the recovery policy permits a transition. Half-open allows limited trial calls before restoring normal traffic or reopening.

Choose explicit failure thresholds, observation windows, timeout behavior, and recovery criteria. Concurrent callers must coordinate probe admission to avoid releasing a new burst into a failing service.
例子：约定连续 3 次失败后打开熔断，之后本地拒绝调用；过 10 秒允许一个 half-open 探测。探测成功才按约定恢复流量，失败则回到 open。探测规则应固定，不能让所有请求同时变成试探而压垮恢复中的服务。

depth.boundary: A circuit breaker does not make retries safe, replace a timeout, or enforce a request-rate quota. Local rejections are not downstream failures.

introduction.definition: 乐观并发先读取再尝试更新，提交时原子检查版本或条件，冲突就拒绝而非覆盖别人。
introduction.example: 库存5、版本7，两位客户都读到版本7，各要买4件。

exercise.question: 只在客户端先检查库存够不够能防超卖吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，两人可能同时看到同一旧库存。

derivation: 写入条件必须在数据库原子验证，例如version=7且stock≥4。
成功后扣库存并推进版本；失败者重新读、重新算，不直接重放旧替换值。

calculation.scenario: 库存5、版本7，两位客户都读到版本7，各要买4件。
steps: 第一位条件成立，库存5−4=1，版本变8。
第二位仍拿版本7，条件失败；重新读1也不够买4，应拒绝。
calculation.result: 第二位仍拿版本7，条件失败；重新读1也不够买4，应拒绝。

application.scenario: 多人同时编辑用户资料。
steps: 响应携带ETag或版本，修改提交If-Match并要求服务端原子检查。
冲突后展示新值并合并意图，避免最后写入者无声覆盖。
application.result: 冲突后展示新值并合并意图，避免最后写入者无声覆盖。

transfer.question: 第二位重读版本8后改买1件，结果呢？
steps: 版本8且库存1满足条件。
扣为0、版本变9，这次是基于新状态重新决定，不是盲目重试。
transfer.answer: 扣为0、版本变9，这次是基于新状态重新决定，不是盲目重试。

blocks.text: A version check such as If-Match rejects a stale replacement. After a conflict, reread the current state and recompute the intended change before retrying.
A state predicate can enforce a local invariant directly, such as stock >= requested quantity before subtracting stock in the same atomic operation.
例子：两个客户端都读到余额版本 7，A 更新后版本变为 8，B 使用 If-Match:7 的覆盖请求应冲突。B 需读取最新状态并重新判断业务条件，而不是把旧值盲目重试到成功。

depth.boundary: A separate read and write do not provide an atomic condition. Conditional mutation alone does not deduplicate repeated business requests or establish a multi-item transaction.

introduction.definition: 幂等让同一操作重试多次仍只产生一次预期效果，解决“已完成但回复丢失”的不确定。
introduction.example: 库存10，订单键K扣3件成功，但客户端没收到回复。

exercise.question: 单次扣库存是原子的，就能安全无限重试吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，多次原子扣减仍会扣多次。

derivation: 将键绑定请求意图，并把去重记录、业务修改和结果保存协调在可靠原子边界中。
重复键返回已有结果；键的作用域、保留期及参数冲突必须明确。

calculation.scenario: 库存10，订单键K扣3件成功，但客户端没收到回复。
steps: 首次K使库存10−3=7，并保存K成功的结果。
同K重试读取旧结果，库存仍7；若当新操作再扣会错成4。
calculation.result: 同K重试读取旧结果，库存仍7；若当新操作再扣会错成4。

application.scenario: 实现可安全重试的创建订单接口。
steps: 客户端为同一意图保留同一键，服务端校验请求内容并执行去重事务。
返回相同业务结果，超出保留期的重试按声明协议处理。
application.result: 返回相同业务结果，超出保留期的重试按声明协议处理。

transfer.question: 同键K这次要求扣5，能直接返回原扣3成功吗？
steps: 请求内容与原意图不同。
应报键冲突或按契约拒绝，不能静默把不同操作当作相同请求。
transfer.answer: 应报键冲突或按契约拒绝，不能静默把不同操作当作相同请求。

blocks.text: A lost response leaves the caller uncertain whether an operation committed. Retrying a decrement can apply the change twice even if every individual decrement is atomic.

Bind an idempotency key to the request intent. Coordinate recording that key, applying the mutation, and retaining its result so duplicate submissions return the earlier outcome. Define key scope, retention, and behavior for the same key with different parameters.
例子：操作 K 要扣减 10，服务器已扣但响应丢失。客户端用同一 K 和相同内容重试，应返回同一次操作结果，不能再扣 10；若复用 K 却把金额改为 20，应报告冲突，而不是静默当作同一请求。

depth.boundary: A timeout does not prove failure. A stock predicate, transport retry, FIFO delivery, or expiring cache entry alone does not guarantee one business effect.

applications.title: Idempotent Processing · 成交与订单的幂等处理
applications.reason: 把安全重试应用于重复执行回报，协调成交身份、现金持仓更新、持久化和崩溃恢复。

introduction.definition: 消息顺序通常只在某个分组内保证；不同分组可并行交错，不代表全局只有一个顺序。
introduction.example: A组A1先于A2，B组B1先于B2。

exercise.question: FIFO分组就保证处理副作用只发生一次吗？
exercise.answer: 不保证，投递重试、确认与副作用去重仍需独立处理。

derivation: 各组只约束本组先后，四个位置中任取两个放A，A内部顺序固定。
其余位置放B，因此交错数为组合数C(4,2)，跨组没有额外因果假设。

calculation.scenario: A组A1先于A2，B组B1先于B2。
steps: 例如A1B1A2B2和B1B2A1A2均合法，A2A1B1B2不合法。
calculation.result: 例如A1B1A2B2和B1B2A1A2均合法，A2A1B1B2不合法。

application.scenario: 按订单处理创建、成交、取消事件。
steps: 以订单身份分组，在组内完成必要副作用后再推进下一事件。
跨订单并行提升吞吐，但跨订单风控不变量需另有协调。
application.result: 跨订单并行提升吞吐，但跨订单风控不变量需另有协调。

transfer.question: A增加A3，B仍2条，合法交错多少？
steps: 从5个位置选3个放固定顺序A1、A2、A3。
C(5,3)=10，增加消息不意味着需要全局串行处理。
transfer.answer: C(5,3)=10，增加消息不意味着需要全局串行处理。

blocks.text: If A1 precedes A2 and B1 precedes B2, six complete interleavings respect these two constraints: choose the two A positions from four slots.
Choose grouping keys that match the business invariant, then process effects in group order. Delivery, handler completion, visibility timeouts, and duplicate effects require separate reasoning.
例子：A 组顺序 A1→A2，B 组顺序 B1→B2，则 A1、B1、B2、A2 是合法交错，A2、A1、B1、B2 则违反 A 组顺序。每组 FIFO 没有定义跨组的唯一全局次序，去重又是独立要求。

depth.boundary: FIFO delivery does not serialize arbitrary asynchronous side effects. A mathematical set of valid schedules does not promise that a queue implements every schedule.

introduction.definition: 一致性哈希把键与节点放在同一圆环，成员变化时只迁移相关区间，避免全部重分配。

exercise.question: 键95找不到更大令牌就无主了吗？
exercise.answer: 不会，顺时针绕回令牌20。

derivation: 键归属于第一个不小于其哈希的令牌，无则绕回。
新增令牌v接管前一令牌之后至v的区间，其他归属不变；虚拟令牌可改善平衡。

steps: 插入40只转移区间(20,40]，键30改归40，其余三键不变。
calculation.result: 插入40只转移区间(20,40]，键30改归40，其余三键不变。

application.scenario: 给缓存集群扩容。
steps: 用固定哈希、排序令牌表及二分查找路由，成员变更按受影响区间迁移。
复制时选择不同物理节点，避免多个虚拟令牌误算为多个容错副本。
application.result: 复制时选择不同物理节点，避免多个虚拟令牌误算为多个容错副本。

transfer.question: 若移除令牌60，原归60的键30去哪里？
steps: 在未插入40的原环中，下一个顺时针令牌为90。
键30转到90，令牌20和90原有键无需重算归属。
transfer.answer: 键30转到90，令牌20和90原有键无需重算归属。

blocks.text: In a clockwise ring, a key belongs to the first token at or after its hash, with wraparound. A sorted token array supports this lookup with binary search.

Inserting a token transfers the interval from the previous token, exclusive, to the new token, inclusive. Virtual tokens can improve balance; replication must select distinct physical owners when required.
例子：环上的节点令牌为 20、60、90，键哈希 50 归到顺时针首个令牌 60。加入令牌 40 后，哈希 30 的键从 60 转到 40，哈希 50 仍归 60。迁移范围由环区间决定，并非所有键重新分配。

depth.boundary: Limited remapping does not imply equal load, automatic data migration, or consistency during reconfiguration. One hot key can remain a bottleneck.

introduction.definition: GPU并行算法把工作分给许多线程，还须安排内存访问和同步，不能只数乘加次数。
introduction.example: 32个线程各读连续4字节，首地址按32字节段对齐，假定按该段模型计数。

exercise.question: 线程多就一定内存访问高效吗？
exercise.answer: 不一定，散乱地址会触及更多内存段。

derivation: 相邻线程读相邻地址可合并访问，事务段数取决于对齐与覆盖范围。
归约或前缀扫描还需同步与参与掩码；浮点加法换树形顺序可能改变舍入。

calculation.scenario: 32个线程各读连续4字节，首地址按32字节段对齐，假定按该段模型计数。
steps: 起点偏移4字节后覆盖地址4至131，跨5个段，而非仍4个。
calculation.result: 起点偏移4字节后覆盖地址4至131，跨5个段，而非仍4个。

application.scenario: 实现每批数据的并行前缀和。
steps: 采用工作量O(n)、依赖深度O(log n)的扫描结构，核对线程块之间的偏移合并。
对照串行结果与容差，测带宽和真实运行时间，避免只看线程数。
application.result: 对照串行结果与容差，测带宽和真实运行时间，避免只看线程数。

transfer.question: 输入[2,1,3,4]的排他扫描与归约分别是什么？
steps: 排他扫描在各位置保存之前元素和，得到[0,2,3,6]。
归约总和10；扫描返回多个前缀，不能用单一总和代替。
transfer.answer: 归约总和10；扫描返回多个前缀，不能用单一总和代替。

blocks.text: Coalescing groups neighboring lane accesses into memory transactions. Under the stated 32-byte segment model, 32 aligned four-byte contiguous loads touch four segments; a one-word shift touches five.

A work-efficient exclusive scan has O(n) work and O(log n) dependency depth. A reduction combines inputs into a total. Participation masks and synchronization are part of correctness; floating-point results can change with the reduction tree.
例子：32 个线程读取连续、对齐的四字节元素，共 128 字节，在简化的 32 字节段模型下触及 4 段。整体错开四字节可能触及 5 段；真实硬件还需核对事务与缓存规则，不能把这个教学段数当所有 GPU 的固定性能倍数。

depth.boundary: Operation count and dependency depth do not predict GPU wall time. Transaction rules depend on architecture, and warp masks do not supply values for absent lanes.

introduction.definition: 分布式缓存一致性处理缓存怎样跟随源数据更新，填充租约可阻止迟到读者把旧值写回。
introduction.example: 读者拿到旧值1后暂停，写者提交2并删缓存，读者随后恢复。

exercise.question: 先写数据库再删缓存就彻底没有旧值回填吗？
exercise.answer: 没有，暂停的旧读者仍可能在删除后把1写回来。

derivation: 缓存缺失时发放该键填充令牌，失效时撤销令牌。
接收回填时原子检查令牌，旧令牌无效则拒绝，阻断所示交错；不等同全局串行化。

calculation.scenario: 读者拿到旧值1后暂停，写者提交2并删缓存，读者随后恢复。
steps: 读者取得令牌7与数据库值1；写者提交2，缓存失效使7作废。
读者用7填1被拒，下一次合法读可获取2，避免把旧1重新变成缓存命中。
calculation.result: 读者用7填1被拒，下一次合法读可获取2，避免把旧1重新变成缓存命中。

application.scenario: 处理热门资料被更新时的缓存回源竞争。
steps: 将填充令牌与按键失效绑定，并让校验与写缓存不可分开。
监控令牌拒绝与失败恢复，TTL仍可限制寿命，但不能代替该竞争控制。
application.result: 监控令牌拒绝与失败恢复，TTL仍可限制寿命，但不能代替该竞争控制。

transfer.question: 若先检查7有效，再暂停，写者使其失效，随后不再检查直接写呢？
steps: 检查和写入之间仍有竞争窗口。
旧值仍可回填；必须原子校验并接收填充，而不是两个独立步骤。
transfer.answer: 旧值仍可回填；必须原子校验并接收填充，而不是两个独立步骤。

blocks.text: In cache-aside, a reader can miss, read an old database value, pause, and refill after a writer commits and deletes the cache entry. Deleting after the database write does not eliminate that interleaving.
Grant a per-key fill token and invalidate it on deletion. Check the token atomically when accepting a fill. A delayed reader with an invalid token cannot repopulate that entry with its old value.
例子：读者从数据库拿到旧值 1 后暂停；写者提交新值 2 并删除缓存；随后读者恢复，把旧值 1 填回缓存。仅仅“先写库再删缓存”仍可能产生这个交错，需要按版本、租约或明确失效协议处理。

depth.boundary: This lease protects the illustrated stale-fill race. It is not a CPU cache-coherence protocol, a normal TTL, or a proof of globally serializable database and cache reads.

introduction.definition: Floyd–Warshall逐步允许更多中转点，一次求出所有点对的最短路费用。
introduction.example: A→B为3，B→C为4，A→C为10。

exercise.question: 没有直接边就可以把距离设0吗？
exercise.answer: 不可以，应为无穷，只有自己到自己初始为0。

derivation: 允许中间点k时，最优路要么不经过k，要么由i到k与k到j拼接。
递推d[i][j]=min(d[i][j],d[i][k]+d[k][j])，k必须在外层以维持阶段含义。

calculation.scenario: A→B为3，B→C为4，A→C为10。
steps: 初始d[A][C]=10，经过B的候选为3+4=7。
更新为min(10,7)=7；三点完整三重循环共27个状态更新尝试。
calculation.result: 更新为min(10,7)=7；三点完整三重循环共27个状态更新尝试。

application.scenario: 小字母表中计算任意字符转换的最低代价。
steps: 初始化有向转换边，重复边取最小，运行全点对递推。
对每个字符串位置查询转换费用并相加，不可达位置须报告无法转换。
application.result: 对每个字符串位置查询转换费用并相加，不可达位置须报告无法转换。

transfer.question: 若增加C→B为−5，有限最短路还成立吗？
steps: B→C→B费用4−5=−1，是可达负环。
受影响路径可反复绕环降低费用，无有限最短值，应检测负对角并标记影响范围。
transfer.answer: 受影响路径可反复绕环降低费用，无有限最短值，应检测负对角并标记影响范围。

blocks.text: Initialize d[i][i] = 0, direct edges to their minimum weight, and missing edges to infinity. For each intermediate vertex k, update d[i][j] = min(d[i][j], d[i][k] + d[k][j]) for every i and j.

Keep k as the outer loop so each stage has a complete intermediate-vertex meaning. The algorithm uses O(V³) time and O(V²) storage for V vertices. A small alphabet of directed character conversions is a natural application.
例子：有 A→B=3、B→C=4、A→C=10。当中间点为 B 时，A 到 C 更新为 min(10,3+4)=7。初始化对角线为 0，缺边为无穷；发现可达负环时，不能把受影响路径当作有限最短路。

depth.boundary: Unreachable pairs remain infinite and must not be treated as free conversions. Negative cycles can make finite shortest-path costs undefined for affected pairs.

introduction.definition: 图的k核是每个点在剩余图中至少有k个邻居的最大诱导子图，像不断淘汰支撑不足的成员。
introduction.example: 三角形A、B、C，另接无向尾边B—D，求2核。

exercise.question: 只检查一开始的度数够吗？
exercise.answer: 不够，删点会减少邻居度数，必须连锁更新。

derivation: 度数低于k的点不可能属于任何最小度至少k的子图，可安全删除。
每删一点就更新仍存邻居，所有不合格点入队；最终剩余满足条件且包含所有可行子图。

calculation.scenario: 三角形A、B、C，另接无向尾边B—D，求2核。
steps: 初始度A=2、B=3、C=2、D=1，D先入队删除。
B降为2，三角形各度2，2核留下3点A、B、C。
calculation.result: B降为2，三角形各度2，2核留下3点A、B、C。

application.scenario: 寻找每位成员至少有两个内部联系的社群候选。
steps: 用当前度数与邻接表迭代剥离，记录被移除的必选成员。
若必选点被删则约束不可行；剩余k核未必连通，也不等于强凝聚或无桥证明。
application.result: 若必选点被删则约束不可行；剩余k核未必连通，也不等于强凝聚或无桥证明。

transfer.question: 同一图把k提高到3，结果怎样？
steps: A、C、D初始都低于3，删除后B失去邻居也低于3。
全部剥离，3核为空，不能只保留初始度3的B。
transfer.answer: 全部剥离，3核为空，不能只保留初始度3的B。

blocks.text: Initialize degrees and enqueue every vertex below the threshold. Removing a vertex reduces each surviving neighbor's degree; enqueue a neighbor when it becomes ineligible. Queue processing with adjacency lists takes O(V + E) time and O(V + E) total storage.

Any feasible induced subgraph with minimum degree at least k survives every removal: a vertex currently below k cannot belong to such a subgraph. This invariant proves both the pruning rule and the maximality of the remainder. A required vertex removed during peeling makes a constrained planting problem impossible.
例子：三角形 A、B、C 加一条 B→D 的无向尾边，求 2-core 时先删除度为 1 的 D，留下三角形。阈值升到 3 时，删除 A、C 后会连锁使 B 也不合格；必须递归更新剩余度数。

depth.boundary: Use current degrees after removals. Core membership differs from connected-component membership; even a 2-core can contain a bridge joining two cyclic regions.

introduction.definition: 平方距离和可以先保存点集的坐标统计量，再对每次查询做固定次数计算。

exercise.question: 这个展开也直接给出普通欧氏距离之和吗？
exercise.answer: 不能，平方根破坏了同一多项式展开。

derivation: 展开(x−a)²+(y−b)²为x²+y²−2ax−2by+a²+b²。
求和后只需n、Sx、Sy、Q，结果n(a²+b²)−2aSx−2bSy+Q。

steps: 本例n=2、Sx=2、Sy=0、Q=4。

application.scenario: 对固定站点反复评价候选服务中心的平方距离总成本。
steps: 一次扫描累计四个统计量，此后每个二维候选只需常数次算术。
使用足够宽的整数或明确精度，取模题需在整个展开中一致处理。
application.result: 使用足够宽的整数或明确精度，取模题需在整个展开中一致处理。

transfer.question: 查询点改成(0,0)，平方距离和多少？
steps: a=b=0，含查询坐标的项全消失。
结果Q=4；普通距离和却为0+2=2，不能混用。
transfer.answer: 结果Q=4；普通距离和却为0+2=2，不能混用。

blocks.text: For n points (x_i, y_i), retain Sx = Σx_i, Sy = Σy_i, and Q = Σ(x_i² + y_i²). At query (a, b), the total squared distance is n(a² + b²) − 2aSx − 2bSy + Q.

Build these moments in O(n) time and evaluate q two-dimensional queries in O(q) time, using O(1) aggregate state. With modular output, reduce the expanded expression consistently and use arithmetic wide enough for every product.
例子：两点为 (0,0)、(2,0)，有 n=2、Sx=2、Sy=0、Q=4。查询 (1,1)，平方距离总和为 2×2−2×1×2+4=4，和逐点算出的 2+2 一致。若改问普通距离，不能再套用这个平方展开。

depth.boundary: The expansion is for squared distances. It does not give the sum of ordinary Euclidean distances. Coordinates and aggregate products can exceed safe integer ranges even when each coordinate fits individually.
